所.zh: 这所大学有一百多年的历史，校园特别美。
所.en: This university is over a hundred years old, and its campus is especially beautiful.

正.zh: 墙上那幅画挂得不正，你帮我往左边调一下。
正.en: That picture on the wall isn't hanging straight; help me shift it a bit to the left.

搞.zh: 刚到新公司，最好先和同事们搞好关系。
搞.en: When you've just joined a new company, it's best to get on good terms with your colleagues first.

如何.zh: 这本书主要介绍如何在短时间内提高写作水平。
如何.en: This book mainly explains how to improve your writing in a short time.

作为.zh: 作为家里的老大，她从小就要照顾弟弟妹妹。
作为.en: As the eldest child, she has had to look after her younger siblings since she was little.

唯一.zh: 这是去山顶的唯一一条路，所以周末人特别多。
唯一.en: This is the only road to the summit, so it is very crowded at weekends.

表现.zh: 这个孩子在学校表现很好，老师经常表扬他。
表现.en: This child behaves well at school, and the teacher often praises him.

方式.zh: 我们可以通过电子邮件的方式联系，不用见面。
方式.en: We can keep in touch by email; there's no need to meet.

处理.zh: 这些旧家具你打算怎么处理？卖掉还是送人？
处理.en: What are you going to do with this old furniture? Sell it or give it away?

政府.zh: 市政府打算明年在这里修一座新的图书馆。
政府.en: The city government plans to build a new library here next year.

系统.zh: 我的手机操作系统升级以后，运行速度快了很多。
系统.en: After my phone's operating system was upgraded, it runs much faster.

杀.zh: 过年的时候，奶奶总要杀一只鸡给全家炖汤。
杀.en: At New Year, Grandma always kills a chicken to make soup for the whole family.

以及.zh: 报名时请带好护照、两张照片以及毕业证书。
以及.en: When registering, please bring your passport, two photos and your graduation certificate.

片.zh: 窗外是一片绿色的草地，看起来特别舒服。
片.en: Outside the window is a stretch of green lawn that looks very pleasant.

拍.zh: 这张照片是我去年在海边拍的。
拍.en: I took this photo at the seaside last year.

控制.zh: 医生让他少吃甜的，好好控制体重。
控制.en: The doctor told him to eat fewer sweets and keep his weight under control.

整个.zh: 这个消息很快就传遍了整个学校。
整个.en: The news quickly spread through the whole school.

组.zh: 这次比赛我和小王分在了同一组。
组.en: In this competition, Xiao Wang and I were put in the same group.

组织.zh: 她大学毕业后加入了一个保护动物的国际组织。
组织.en: After graduating from university, she joined an international animal-protection organization.

根本.zh: 这件事和他根本没有关系，你别怪他了。
根本.en: This has nothing at all to do with him, so stop blaming him.

目前.zh: 目前我们公司还没有在国外开分店的计划。
目前.en: At present our company has no plans to open branches abroad.

存在.zh: 科学家一直在研究其他星球上是否存在生命。
存在.en: Scientists have long been studying whether life exists on other planets.

靠.zh: 坐飞机的时候，我习惯选靠窗的座位。
靠.en: When I fly, I usually choose a window seat.

个人.zh: 请保护好自己的个人信息，不要随便告诉陌生人。
个人.en: Protect your personal information and don't give it to strangers casually.

精神.zh: 睡了一个好觉以后，他今天看起来特别有精神。
精神.en: After a good night's sleep, he looks very energetic today.

代表.zh: 红色在中国文化中代表着幸福和好运。
代表.en: In Chinese culture, red represents happiness and good luck.

保持.zh: 图书馆里请保持安静，不要大声打电话。
保持.en: Please keep quiet in the library and don't make loud phone calls.

确定.zh: 我不太确定他今天会不会来，你最好再问问。
确定.en: I'm not quite sure whether he's coming today; you'd better ask again.

目标.zh: 公司今年的销售目标是比去年增加百分之二十。
目标.en: The company's sales target this year is a 20% increase over last year.

中心.zh: 这座购物中心里有很多饭馆和电影院。
中心.en: This shopping center has lots of restaurants and cinemas.

首.zh: 她给男朋友写了一首诗，表达自己的感情。
首.en: She wrote her boyfriend a poem to express her feelings.

行动.zh: 他的腿受伤了，现在行动很不方便。
行动.en: His leg is injured, so it's hard for him to get around now.

合作.zh: 这本书是两位作者合作完成的。
合作.en: This book was written by two authors working together.

人员.zh: 这家医院的医护人员每天都非常忙。
人员.en: The medical staff at this hospital are extremely busy every day.

哈.zh: 哈，原来你躲在这里，我找了你半天！
哈.en: Aha, so you were hiding here! I've been looking for you for ages!

报告.zh: 下午三点在大礼堂有一场关于健康饮食的报告。
报告.en: At 3 p.m. there is a talk on healthy eating in the main hall.

治疗.zh: 这种病越早治疗，效果越好。
治疗.en: The earlier this illness is treated, the better the results.

家庭.zh: 她既要工作又要照顾家庭，每天都很辛苦。
家庭.en: She has to work and also look after her family, so every day is hard.

明显.zh: 这两张照片的区别很明显，你一眼就能看出来。
明显.en: The difference between these two photos is obvious; you can see it at a glance.

套.zh: 面试的时候，他穿了一套深蓝色的西服。
套.en: He wore a dark blue suit to the interview.

曾经.zh: 这座小楼曾经是一所学校，现在变成了咖啡馆。
曾经.en: This small building was once a school; now it has become a café.

血.zh: 他每年都去医院献一次血，帮助需要的人。
血.en: He goes to the hospital to donate blood once a year to help people in need.

行为.zh: 孩子的行为习惯很大程度上受到父母的影响。
行为.en: A child's behavior is largely shaped by their parents.

克.zh: 医生说每天吃盐不要超过六克。
克.en: The doctor says you shouldn't eat more than six grams of salt a day.

装.zh: 他明明听到了我叫他，却装作没听见。
装.en: He clearly heard me calling him, but pretended he hadn't.

绝对.zh: 开车之前绝对不能喝酒，这是很危险的。
绝对.en: You absolutely must not drink before driving; it's very dangerous.

派.zh: 医院派了一辆救护车来接病人。
派.en: The hospital sent an ambulance to pick up the patient.

设计.zh: 这座桥是一位年轻的工程师设计的。
设计.en: This bridge was designed by a young engineer.

未来.zh: 未来几天会一直下雨，出门记得带伞。
未来.en: It will keep raining for the next few days, so remember to take an umbrella.

利用.zh: 我们可以利用旧报纸做一些小手工。
利用.en: We can use old newspapers to make some small handicrafts.

包括.zh: 全班包括老师在内，一共有三十个人。
包括.en: Including the teacher, there are thirty people in the class.

抓.zh: 小猫跳起来想抓那只蝴蝶。
抓.en: The kitten jumped up trying to catch the butterfly.

意义.zh: 对我来说，这块旧手表有特别的意义，因为它是爷爷送的。
意义.en: This old watch has special meaning for me, because my grandfather gave it to me.

便.zh: 天一黑，街上便安静了下来。
便.en: As soon as it got dark, the street grew quiet.

项.zh: 他在运动会上参加了三项比赛。
项.en: He took part in three events at the sports meet.

数.zh: 全班同学里，数他跑得最快。
数.en: Of all the students in the class, he runs the fastest.

报道.zh: 很多报纸都报道了这位老人免费教孩子画画的事。
报道.en: Many newspapers reported on this old man teaching children to paint for free.

力量.zh: 这个小伙子力量很大，一个人就能搬动冰箱。
力量.en: This young man is very strong; he can move a fridge by himself.

项目.zh: 游泳是他最喜欢的体育项目。

造成.zh: 长时间看手机会对眼睛造成伤害。
造成.en: Looking at your phone for long periods can damage your eyes.

某.zh: 据说某位明星下周要来我们学校演出。
某.en: They say a certain celebrity is coming to perform at our school next week.

支.zh: 我们学校的这支足球队曾经得过全市冠军。
支.en: Our school's football team once won the city championship.

人生.zh: 大学四年是人生中最美好的一段时光。
人生.en: The four years of university are the best time of one's life.

非.zh: 孩子非要买那个玩具，不给就哭。
非.en: The child insists on buying that toy and cries if he doesn't get it.

失去.zh: 因为一次小错误，他失去了大家的信任。
失去.en: Because of one small mistake, he lost everyone's trust.

则.zh: 我今天在网上看到一则有趣的新闻。
则.en: I saw an interesting news item online today.

面对.zh: 面对这么多观众，她一点儿也不紧张。
面对.en: Facing such a large audience, she wasn't nervous at all.

训练.zh: 这只狗经过训练，能帮助盲人过马路。
训练.en: This dog has been trained to help blind people cross the road.

总统.zh: 这位前总统退休后开始写书。
总统.en: This former president started writing books after retiring.

部门.zh: 我刚来公司，还不太熟悉其他部门的同事。
部门.en: I've just joined the company and don't know colleagues in other departments well yet.

似乎.zh: 天阴沉沉的，似乎要下雨了。
似乎.en: The sky is dark and gloomy; it seems it's going to rain.

宝贝.zh: 宝贝，别哭了，妈妈马上就回来。
宝贝.en: Don't cry, sweetheart, Mommy will be right back.

位置.zh: 这张桌子放在门口不太方便，我们换个位置吧。
位置.en: This table is in the way by the door; let's move it somewhere else.

方.zh: 这种饼干有圆的，也有方的，你喜欢哪种？
方.en: These biscuits come in round and square shapes; which do you prefer?

参与.zh: 这部电影从写剧本到拍摄，他全程参与了。
参与.en: He was involved in this film the whole way, from writing the script to shooting it.

显示.zh: 手机屏幕上显示有三个未接电话。
显示.en: The phone screen shows three missed calls.

属于.zh: 这片森林属于国家，任何人都不能随便砍树。
属于.en: This forest belongs to the state; no one may cut down trees at will.

人类.zh: 从古到今，狗一直是人类最忠实的朋友。
人类.en: Throughout history, the dog has always been humankind's most loyal friend.

手术.zh: 做完手术以后，他需要在医院住一个星期。
手术.en: After the operation, he needs to stay in hospital for a week.

兄弟.zh: 我和他从小一起长大，就像亲兄弟一样。
兄弟.en: He and I grew up together, just like real brothers.

自由.zh: 放假了，孩子们可以自由地安排自己的时间。
自由.en: Now that it's the holidays, the children can arrange their time freely.

夜.zh: 到了夜里，山上的温度会降得很低。
夜.en: At night, the temperature on the mountain drops very low.

事实.zh: 他说自己生病了，但事实上他是去旅游了。
事实.en: He said he was sick, but in fact he went traveling.

基本.zh: 这项工作我已经基本完成了，明天就能交。
基本.en: I've basically finished this task and can hand it in tomorrow.

居然.zh: 他平时很少学习，这次考试居然得了第一名。
居然.en: He hardly ever studies, yet to everyone's surprise he came first in this exam.

专家.zh: 这位环保专家今天下午要来学校做讲座。
专家.en: This environmental expert is coming to give a lecture at the school this afternoon.

称.zh: 她每天早上都要称一下体重。

分析.zh: 老师帮我分析了这次作文的优点和缺点。
分析.en: The teacher helped me analyze the strengths and weaknesses of my essay.

享受.zh: 周末躺在沙发上看书，真是一种享受。
享受.en: Lying on the sofa reading at the weekend is a real pleasure.

以来.zh: 开学以来，我已经认识了很多新朋友。
以来.en: Since the start of term, I've already made many new friends.

反应.zh: 这只猫反应很快，一下子就跳开了。
反应.en: This cat has quick reactions; it jumped away in an instant.

地区.zh: 南方地区夏天经常下大雨。
地区.en: In the southern region, it often rains heavily in summer.

资料.zh: 老师在网上给我们发了一些复习资料。
资料.en: The teacher sent us some revision materials online.

冠军.zh: 这支球队已经连续三年获得全国冠军了。
冠军.en: This team has won the national championship three years in a row.

价值.zh: 这枚旧邮票现在的价值已经超过一万元。
价值.en: This old stamp is now worth more than ten thousand yuan.

相当.zh: 他的中文水平相当高，跟中国人说话没问题。
相当.en: His Chinese is quite advanced; he has no trouble talking with Chinese people.

实现.zh: 这个计划听起来不错，但很难实现。
实现.en: This plan sounds good, but it will be hard to carry out.

产生.zh: 两个人对这个问题产生了不同的看法。
产生.en: The two of them came to hold different views on this question.

对方.zh: 打电话时，对方说话声音太小，我听不清楚。
对方.en: On the phone, the other person spoke so quietly that I couldn't hear clearly.

状态.zh: 今天他的状态特别好，一口气跑了十公里。
状态.en: He was in great form today and ran ten kilometers without stopping.

心理.zh: 孩子成长过程中，父母要多关心他们的心理健康。
心理.en: As children grow up, parents should pay attention to their mental health.

群.zh: 湖上有一群白色的鸭子在游来游去。
群.en: A flock of white ducks is swimming around on the lake.

根.zh: 这根绳子太短了，绑不住箱子。
根.en: This rope is too short to tie up the box.

建立.zh: 老师的鼓励帮他慢慢建立起了自信。
建立.en: The teacher's encouragement gradually helped him build up his self-confidence.

老板.zh: 这家面馆的老板每天早上五点就开门了。
老板.en: The owner of this noodle shop opens up at five every morning.

市场.zh: 妈妈每天早上都去菜市场买新鲜的蔬菜。
市场.en: Every morning Mom goes to the food market to buy fresh vegetables.

必要.zh: 如果有必要，我可以陪你一起去医院。
必要.en: If necessary, I can go to the hospital with you.

抢.zh: 地铁一到站，大家都抢着上车。
抢.en: As soon as the subway pulled in, everyone rushed to get on first.

日子.zh: 结婚以后，他们的日子过得很幸福。
日子.en: After they married, they lived a very happy life.

傻.zh: 你真傻，这么好的机会为什么不要？
傻.en: How silly of you! Why would you turn down such a good opportunity?

亲爱.zh: 亲爱的妈妈，祝您生日快乐！

救.zh: 那个男孩掉进河里，幸好被路人救了上来。
救.en: The boy fell into the river; luckily a passer-by pulled him out.

恢复.zh: 大雪停了以后，城里的交通慢慢恢复了正常。
恢复.en: After the heavy snow stopped, traffic in the city gradually returned to normal.

或许.zh: 你别着急，或许他只是路上堵车了。
或许.en: Don't worry; perhaps he's just stuck in traffic.

达到.zh: 今天的气温达到了三十八度。

投资.zh: 很多年轻人开始学习如何理财和投资。
投资.en: Many young people are starting to learn how to manage money and invest.

现实.zh: 这个想法很好，可是不太现实。
现实.en: It's a nice idea, but not very realistic.

不断.zh: 这家饭馆不断推出新菜，吸引了很多客人。
不断.en: This restaurant keeps introducing new dishes, which attracts lots of customers.

媒体.zh: 这位歌手很少接受媒体的采访。
媒体.en: This singer rarely gives interviews to the media.

追.zh: 他追了她两年，她终于答应做他女朋友了。
追.en: He pursued her for two years, and she finally agreed to be his girlfriend.

导致.zh: 长期不吃早饭可能导致胃病。
导致.en: Skipping breakfast for a long time may lead to stomach problems.

集中.zh: 这个城市的大学大多集中在城北。
集中.en: Most of this city's universities are concentrated in the north of town.

战争.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个家庭在战争中失散又重逢的故事。
战争.en: This film tells the story of a family separated during the war and later reunited.

理由.zh: 他迟到的理由是闹钟没响。
理由.en: His excuse for being late was that his alarm clock didn't go off.

感受.zh: 第一次站在舞台上，你有什么感受？
感受.en: How did it feel to stand on a stage for the first time?

完美.zh: 这次演出非常完美，观众们都站起来鼓掌。
完美.en: The performance was perfect, and the whole audience stood up to applaud.

伤害.zh: 说话前要多想想，别伤害别人的感情。
伤害.en: Think before you speak, and don't hurt other people's feelings.

真实.zh: 这篇报道里的数字都是真实的吗？
真实.en: Are all the figures in this report real?

记录.zh: 医生把病人的情况详细地记录在本子上。
记录.en: The doctor recorded the patient's condition in detail in a notebook.

空间.zh: 这辆车虽然小，但后面的空间很大，能放三个箱子。
空间.en: Although this car is small, there is plenty of room in the back for three suitcases.

冲.zh: 早上起来，他先给自己冲了一杯咖啡。
冲.en: When he gets up in the morning, he first makes himself a cup of coffee.

期待.zh: 歌迷们都在期待这位歌手的新专辑。
期待.en: Fans are all looking forward to this singer's new album.

政治.zh: 他大学读的是政治专业，现在在报社工作。
政治.en: He majored in political science at university and now works at a newspaper.

朝.zh: 他朝我挥了挥手，然后上了车。
朝.en: He waved at me and then got into the car.

一旦.zh: 密码一旦忘记，就只能重新设置了。
一旦.en: Once you forget the password, the only option is to reset it.

范围.zh: 这家快递公司的服务范围覆盖全国。
范围.en: This courier company's service area covers the whole country.

承认.zh: 虽然输了比赛，但我们必须承认对手比我们强。
承认.en: Although we lost the match, we have to admit our opponents were stronger.

痛苦.zh: 牙疼的时候，他痛苦得一晚上没睡着。
痛苦.en: When he had toothache, he was in such pain that he couldn't sleep all night.

文件.zh: 我不小心把电脑里的文件删掉了。
文件.en: I accidentally deleted the file on my computer.

显然.zh: 从他的表情看，他显然不喜欢这个礼物。
显然.en: Judging by his expression, he obviously doesn't like this present.

传统.zh: 包饺子是我们家过年的传统。
传统.en: Making dumplings is our family's New Year tradition.

状况.zh: 医生每天都会检查病人的身体状况。
状况.en: The doctor checks the patients' physical condition every day.

翻.zh: 她把这本英文小说翻成了中文。
翻.en: She translated this English novel into Chinese.

作品.zh: 这次画展一共展出了一百多幅作品。
作品.en: More than a hundred works were shown at this art exhibition.

时代.zh: 时代在变化，人们的生活方式也在变化。
时代.en: Times are changing, and so is the way people live.

伟大.zh: 母爱是世界上最伟大的爱。
伟大.en: A mother's love is the greatest love in the world.

嗯.zh: 嗯，这个汤味道不错，再给我来一碗。
嗯.en: Mm, this soup tastes good; give me another bowl.

的确.zh: 你说得没错，这件衣服的确有点儿贵。
的确.en: You're right, this piece of clothing is indeed a bit expensive.

颗.zh: 他笑起来的时候露出两颗白白的牙齿。
颗.en: When he smiles, he shows two white teeth.

身份.zh: 他一直没有告诉大家自己的真实身份。
身份.en: He never told anyone his true identity.

充满.zh: 春天到了，她的房间里充满了花香。
充满.en: Spring has come, and her room is filled with the scent of flowers.

人物.zh: 这部电视剧里我最喜欢的人物是那个老爷爷。
人物.en: My favorite character in this TV series is the old grandfather.

系.zh: 她大学读的是历史系，现在在博物馆工作。
系.en: She studied in the history department at university and now works in a museum.

直.zh: 他说话很直，有时候会让人不高兴。
直.en: He speaks very bluntly, which sometimes upsets people.

产品.zh: 这款新产品一上市就受到了顾客的欢迎。
产品.en: This new product was popular with customers as soon as it hit the market.

枪.zh: 小时候，他最喜欢的玩具是一把水枪。
枪.en: As a child, his favorite toy was a water gun.

年代.zh: 我爷爷出生在二十世纪三十年代。
年代.en: My grandfather was born in the 1930s.

保险.zh: 把钱放在银行里比放在家里保险。
保险.en: Keeping money in the bank is safer than keeping it at home.

领导.zh: 在他的领导下，这个团队取得了很好的成绩。
领导.en: Under his leadership, the team achieved excellent results.

寻找.zh: 科学家们正在寻找治疗这种病的新方法。
寻找.en: Scientists are looking for new ways to treat this disease.

胜利.zh: 经过一个小时的比赛，红队最后获得了胜利。
胜利.en: After an hour of play, the red team finally won.

梦想.zh: 他梦想有一天能开着车环游世界。
梦想.en: He dreams of driving around the world one day.

明星.zh: 这位足球明星在机场被很多球迷围住了。
明星.en: This football star was surrounded by fans at the airport.

受伤.zh: 从楼梯上摔下来以后，他的腿受伤了。
受伤.en: He hurt his leg after falling down the stairs.

程度.zh: 这个病人受伤的程度不太严重，休息几天就好。
程度.en: The patient's injuries are not very serious; a few days' rest will be enough.

理论.zh: 他的理论知识很丰富，但缺少实际经验。
理论.en: He has a lot of theoretical knowledge but lacks practical experience.

网络.zh: 现在通过网络就可以买到各种各样的东西。
网络.en: Nowadays you can buy all kinds of things over the internet.

宣布.zh: 比赛结束后，裁判宣布我们队获胜。
宣布.en: After the match, the referee announced that our team had won.

姑娘.zh: 这个小姑娘才五岁，就会弹钢琴了。
姑娘.en: This little girl is only five, and she can already play the piano.

创造.zh: 人们用自己的双手创造了美好的生活。
创造.en: People created a good life with their own hands.

呆.zh: 周末他在家里呆了两天，哪儿也没去。
呆.en: At the weekend he stayed at home for two days and didn't go anywhere.

雷.zh: 雷声太大了，把睡着的孩子吵醒了。
雷.en: The thunder was so loud that it woke the sleeping child.

数据.zh: 这份报告里的数据都是去年调查得到的。
数据.en: The data in this report all come from last year's survey.

圈.zh: 他每天晚上都绕着操场跑十圈。
圈.en: Every evening he runs ten laps around the sports field.

思想.zh: 这位老教授的思想很开放，很受学生欢迎。
思想.en: This old professor is very open-minded and popular with students.

破坏.zh: 请不要破坏公园里的花草树木。
破坏.en: Please do not damage the flowers, grass and trees in the park.

消失.zh: 太阳出来以后，地上的雾很快就消失了。
消失.en: Once the sun came out, the fog on the ground quickly disappeared.

稳定.zh: 这几天天气不太稳定，一会儿晴一会儿雨。
稳定.en: The weather has been unstable these days, sunny one moment and rainy the next.

巨大.zh: 这座城市有一个巨大的广场，可以容纳几万人。
巨大.en: This city has a huge square that can hold tens of thousands of people.

龙.zh: 端午节的时候，很多地方都会举行龙舟比赛。
龙.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, many places hold dragon boat races.

英雄.zh: 在孩子的眼里，爸爸就是一个英雄。
英雄.en: In a child's eyes, Dad is a hero.

满足.zh: 他是个很容易满足的人，有饭吃、有书看就很开心。
满足.en: He's easily satisfied; as long as he has food to eat and books to read, he's happy.

土地.zh: 爷爷一辈子都在这片土地上种粮食。
土地.en: Grandpa spent his whole life growing grain on this land.

威胁.zh: 这只猫觉得受到了威胁，身上的毛都竖了起来。
威胁.en: The cat felt threatened, and all its fur stood on end.

老婆.zh: 他老婆做的红烧肉特别好吃。
老婆.en: The braised pork his wife makes is especially delicious.

等待.zh: 病人们坐在走廊里等待医生叫号。
等待.en: The patients sat in the corridor waiting for the doctor to call their numbers.

挑战.zh: 他决定挑战自己，参加一次马拉松比赛。
挑战.en: He decided to challenge himself by running a marathon.

占.zh: 女生占了我们班人数的一半以上。
占.en: Girls make up more than half of our class.

秘密.zh: 这家饭馆的红烧肉做得这么好吃，有什么秘密吗？
秘密.en: This restaurant's braised pork is so good — is there some secret to it?

超级.zh: 这个包超级轻，带着出门很方便。
超级.en: This bag is super light, so it's very convenient to take out.

猪.zh: 这只小猪胖胖的，样子特别可爱。
猪.en: This little pig is chubby and looks really cute.

设备.zh: 这家健身房的设备都是新的。
设备.en: All the equipment in this gym is new.

团.zh: 学校合唱团下个月要去北京演出。
团.en: The school choir is going to perform in Beijing next month.

制造.zh: 这个孩子上课总是制造麻烦。
制造.en: This child is always causing trouble in class.

对手.zh: 下棋的时候，他从来不小看任何对手。
对手.en: When playing chess, he never underestimates any opponent.

俱乐部.zh: 我们学校有一个英语俱乐部，每周三活动一次。
俱乐部.en: Our school has an English club that meets every Wednesday.

想象.zh: 这里的风景比我想象的还要美。
想象.en: The scenery here is even more beautiful than I imagined.

当地.zh: 我们请了一位当地的导游带我们参观。
当地.en: We hired a local guide to show us around.

顿.zh: 他因为考试没考好，被爸爸骂了一顿。
顿.en: He got a scolding from his father for doing badly in the exam.

顶.zh: 我们爬了三个小时，终于到达了山顶。
顶.en: We climbed for three hours and finally reached the top of the mountain.

背.zh: 他每天早上都要背二十个英语单词。
背.en: Every morning he memorizes twenty English words.

特殊.zh: 这把钥匙的形状很特殊，很难复制。
特殊.en: This key has an unusual shape and is hard to copy.

具体.zh: 我们先定一个大概的计划，具体时间以后再说。
具体.en: Let's make a rough plan first; we'll decide the exact time later.

风格.zh: 这家咖啡馆的装修风格很有特色。
风格.en: The decor style of this café is very distinctive.

建筑.zh: 他大学学的是建筑设计，现在在一家公司当工程师。
建筑.en: He studied architectural design at university and now works as an engineer at a company.

角色.zh: 这个角色很难演，很多演员都不敢接。
角色.en: This role is hard to play, and many actors are afraid to take it on.

疯狂.zh: 打折第一天，商场里到处都是疯狂购物的人。
疯狂.en: On the first day of the sale, the mall was full of people shopping like crazy.

彻底.zh: 过年前，我们把家里彻底打扫了一遍。
彻底.en: Before New Year, we gave the house a thorough cleaning.

表达.zh: 小孩子还不会用语言表达自己的需要。
表达.en: Small children can't yet express their needs in words.

投入.zh: 她演奏钢琴时非常投入，完全忘了周围的人。
投入.en: When she plays the piano she is completely absorbed and forgets everyone around her.

幅.zh: 他花了三个月才画完这幅山水画。
幅.en: It took him three months to finish this landscape painting.

亮.zh: 房间里的灯一直亮着，他还没睡吗？
亮.en: The light in his room is still on — isn't he asleep yet?

出口.zh: 电影结束后，观众们从左边的出口离开。
出口.en: After the film, the audience left through the exit on the left.

布.zh: 她用一块旧布把桌子擦干净了。
布.en: She wiped the table clean with an old piece of cloth.

权利.zh: 顾客有权利要求商店退换质量有问题的商品。
权利.en: Customers have the right to ask the shop to exchange or refund faulty goods.

采取.zh: 为了减少浪费，学校食堂采取了新的办法。
采取.en: To reduce waste, the school canteen adopted a new approach.

意外.zh: 他在路上发生了一点儿意外，所以迟到了。
意外.en: He had a minor accident on the way, so he was late.

期间.zh: 比赛期间，所有运动员都住在这家酒店。
期间.en: During the competition, all the athletes stay at this hotel.

风险.zh: 在没有保护的情况下爬山，风险太大了。
风险.en: Climbing without protection is far too risky.

时刻.zh: 开车的时候要时刻注意路上的情况。
时刻.en: When driving, you must pay attention to the road at all times.

平.zh: 这场比赛两队打平了，比分是一比一。
平.en: The two teams drew this match; the score was one-all.

断.zh: 说着说着，电话突然断了。
断.en: In the middle of our conversation, the phone line suddenly went dead.

观察.zh: 孩子们每天观察小豆子的发芽和生长。
观察.en: Every day the children observe the little beans sprouting and growing.

恨.zh: 他很恨那个骗了他很多钱的朋友。
恨.en: He really hates the friend who cheated him out of a lot of money.

接近.zh: 这座山的高度接近三千米。
接近.en: This mountain is close to three thousand meters high.

敌人.zh: 在动物世界里，猫是老鼠的敌人。
敌人.en: In the animal world, the cat is the mouse's enemy.

重大.zh: 他的研究在医学上有重大的发现。
重大.en: His research made a major discovery in medicine.

表明.zh: 他用行动表明了自己的决心。
表明.en: He showed his determination through his actions.

时尚.zh: 这家店的衣服又便宜又时尚。
时尚.en: The clothes in this shop are both cheap and fashionable.

墙.zh: 这面墙刚刷过油漆，千万别用手去碰。
墙.en: This wall has just been painted, so whatever you do, don't touch it.

程序.zh: 他会写电脑程序，经常帮朋友做网站。
程序.en: He can write computer programs and often builds websites for friends.

持续.zh: 如果发烧持续不退，就要马上去医院。
持续.en: If the fever persists, go to the hospital right away.

和平.zh: 鸽子常常被看作和平的象征。
和平.en: The dove is often seen as a symbol of peace.

切.zh: 妈妈正在厨房里切菜，准备做晚饭。
切.en: Mom is in the kitchen chopping vegetables to make dinner.

合同.zh: 工作之前，你应该先看清楚合同的内容。
合同.en: Before starting a job, you should read the contract carefully.

食物.zh: 冬天来了，小松鼠开始储存食物。
食物.en: Winter has come, and the little squirrel has started storing food.

发表.zh: 会上，每个人都发表了自己的看法。
发表.en: At the meeting, everyone expressed their own views.

相关.zh: 他找了一份和自己专业相关的工作。
相关.en: He found a job related to his major.

偷.zh: 弟弟趁我不在，偷吃了冰箱里的蛋糕。
偷.en: While I was out, my little brother secretly ate the cake in the fridge.

简直.zh: 他画的猫简直跟真的一样。
简直.en: The cat he drew looks just like a real one.

退.zh: 看到那只大狗，她吓得往后退了两步。
退.en: When she saw the big dog, she was so scared that she stepped back two paces.

情绪.zh: 考试前要控制好自己的情绪，不要太紧张。
情绪.en: Before an exam, keep your emotions under control and don't get too nervous.

信号.zh: 他向我做了一个手势，这是让大家出发的信号。
信号.en: He made a gesture to me; it was the signal for everyone to set off.

官.zh: 他从小就想当一名外交官。
官.en: Ever since he was little, he has wanted to be a diplomat.

掌握.zh: 这门技术不难，你练几次就能掌握。
掌握.en: This skill isn't hard; you'll master it after a few tries.

证据.zh: 你说他拿了你的书，有什么证据吗？
证据.en: You say he took your book — do you have any proof?

幸运.zh: 他很幸运，在最后一分钟赶上了火车。
幸运.en: He was lucky and caught the train at the last minute.

制作.zh: 这个蛋糕是我和妹妹亲手制作的。
制作.en: My younger sister and I made this cake ourselves.

教练.zh: 我们的游泳教练对每个人都很严格。
教练.en: Our swimming coach is strict with everyone.

记忆.zh: 童年的很多记忆，现在都已经变得模糊了。
记忆.en: Many childhood memories have now grown hazy.

公开.zh: 他们俩谈恋爱的事还没有公开。
公开.en: They haven't made their relationship public yet.

资金.zh: 开一家咖啡馆至少需要五十万元的资金。
资金.en: Opening a café requires at least 500,000 yuan in capital.

员工.zh: 公司每年都会给员工组织一次体检。
员工.en: Every year the company arranges a health check for its employees.

摆.zh: 她把照片整齐地摆在书架上。
摆.en: She arranged the photos neatly on the bookshelf.

吓.zh: 那部电影太恐怖了，把孩子吓哭了。
吓.en: That film was so scary that it frightened the child to tears.

立即.zh: 发现着火后，请立即拨打火警电话。
立即.en: If you discover a fire, please call the fire department immediately.

升.zh: 他工作努力，今年升为部门经理了。
升.en: He works hard and was promoted to department manager this year.

内部.zh: 这座建筑外面看起来很旧，内部却非常现代。
内部.en: This building looks old from outside, but the interior is very modern.

经营.zh: 这家小店由一对老夫妻经营了三十年。
经营.en: This small shop has been run by an elderly couple for thirty years.

在于.zh: 这两种方法的区别在于速度不同。
在于.en: The difference between these two methods lies in their speed.

发挥.zh: 在这个团队里，每个人都能发挥自己的长处。
发挥.en: In this team, everyone can make full use of their strengths.

立刻.zh: 你要是不舒服，就立刻告诉我。
立刻.en: If you feel unwell, tell me right away.

独立.zh: 她十八岁就离开家，开始独立工作了。
独立.en: She left home at eighteen and began working independently.

实验.zh: 同学们在老师的帮助下完成了一个化学实验。
实验.en: With the teacher's help, the students completed a chemistry experiment.

吹.zh: 她吹灭了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。
吹.en: She blew out the candles on her birthday cake.

取消.zh: 因为张老师生病了，明天的汉语课取消了。
取消.en: Because Teacher Zhang is ill, tomorrow's Chinese class has been cancelled.

表情.zh: 看他的表情，就知道他考得不错。
表情.en: From the look on his face, you can tell he did well in the exam.

采访.zh: 这位作家很少接受记者采访。
采访.en: This writer seldom gives interviews to reporters.

通常.zh: 我通常七点起床，八点出门。
通常.en: I usually get up at seven and leave home at eight.

针对.zh: 这本教材是针对外国留学生编写的。
针对.en: This textbook was written specifically for international students.

角度.zh: 从这个角度拍照，可以看到整座山。
角度.en: If you take the photo from this angle, you can see the whole mountain.

遗憾.zh: 没能看到这场比赛，真是太遗憾了。
遗憾.en: It's a real pity I couldn't see this match.

对象.zh: 她最近找到了一个对象，是一名中学老师。
对象.en: She recently found a boyfriend; he's a secondary-school teacher.

接触.zh: 这种病会通过接触传播，大家要多洗手。
接触.en: This disease spreads through contact, so everyone should wash their hands often.

规则.zh: 新来的同学还不太了解这个游戏的规则。
规则.en: The new student doesn't really know the rules of this game yet.

欧洲.zh: 法国和德国都是欧洲国家。
欧洲.en: France and Germany are both European countries.

损失.zh: 钱包丢了不要紧，最大的损失是里面的照片。
损失.en: Losing the wallet doesn't matter much; the biggest loss is the photos inside.

合理.zh: 你的要求很合理，我们会尽快解决。
合理.en: Your request is reasonable; we'll sort it out as soon as possible.

依然.zh: 已经晚上十点了，图书馆里依然坐满了学生。
依然.en: It's already ten at night, yet the library is still full of students.

阶段.zh: 学习外语的初级阶段，听和说特别重要。
阶段.en: In the beginning stage of learning a foreign language, listening and speaking are especially important.

成熟.zh: 这些西红柿还没有成熟，再等几天吧。
成熟.en: These tomatoes aren't ripe yet; wait a few more days.

一致.zh: 大家对这个方案的意见很一致。
一致.en: Everyone is in complete agreement about this plan.

吐.zh: 他晕车很厉害，一上车就想吐。
吐.en: He gets badly carsick and feels like throwing up as soon as he gets in.

信任.zh: 朋友之间最重要的是互相信任。
信任.en: The most important thing between friends is mutual trust.

反正.zh: 我们打车去吧，反正也不贵。
反正.en: Let's take a taxi; it's not expensive anyway.

刺激.zh: 第一次坐过山车，感觉特别刺激。
刺激.en: Riding a roller coaster for the first time felt really thrilling.

尽快.zh: 我的签证快到期了，得尽快去办手续。
尽快.en: My visa is about to expire, so I need to sort out the paperwork as soon as possible.

赶紧.zh: 孩子发烧了，你赶紧带他去医院。
赶紧.en: The child has a fever; hurry and take him to the hospital.

移动.zh: 台风正在向东南方向移动。
移动.en: The typhoon is moving toward the southeast.

销售.zh: 这本书在网上的销售情况非常好。
销售.en: This book is selling very well online.

呼吸.zh: 我感冒了，鼻子不通，呼吸很困难。
呼吸.en: I have a cold; my nose is blocked and it's hard to breathe.

可怕.zh: 这条路上车开得太快了，真可怕。
可怕.en: Cars drive so fast on this road; it's really frightening.

确认.zh: 订好酒店以后，你会收到一封确认邮件。
确认.en: After booking the hotel, you will receive a confirmation email.

出色.zh: 他是一名出色的翻译，中英文都很好。
出色.en: He is an outstanding translator, excellent in both Chinese and English.

调整.zh: 到了国外，我花了一个星期才调整好时差。
调整.en: After arriving abroad, it took me a week to adjust to the time difference.

滴.zh: 水龙头没关好，一直在滴水。
滴.en: The tap wasn't turned off properly and keeps dripping.

滚.zh: 孩子们躺在草坡上，一个接一个地滚了下去。
滚.en: Lying on the grassy slope, the children rolled down it one after another.

逃.zh: 大火发生后，楼里的人都安全逃了出来。
逃.en: After the fire broke out, everyone in the building escaped safely.

婚姻.zh: 她认为婚姻需要两个人共同经营。
婚姻.en: She believes a marriage needs both people to work at it together.

喊.zh: 妈妈在楼下喊我回家吃饭。
喊.en: Mom is calling me from downstairs to come home for dinner.

紧急.zh: 公司有一件紧急的事，经理让我马上回去。
紧急.en: There's something urgent at the company, and the manager wants me back right away.

宣传.zh: 同学们在街上发传单，宣传保护环境的知识。
宣传.en: The students handed out leaflets on the street to promote environmental protection.

撞.zh: 他走路时一直低头看手机，一头撞在了玻璃门上。
撞.en: He kept looking down at his phone while walking and walked straight into a glass door.

优势.zh: 这家店的优势是离地铁站很近。
优势.en: This shop's advantage is that it's very close to the subway station.

随时.zh: 这里天气变化很快，随时可能下雨。
随时.en: The weather changes fast here; it could rain at any moment.

时期.zh: 唐朝是中国诗歌最发达的时期。
时期.en: The Tang dynasty was the period when Chinese poetry flourished most.

哎.zh: 哎，你怎么现在才来？我们都等你半天了。
哎.en: Hey, why are you only getting here now? We've been waiting ages for you.

措施.zh: 为了防止感冒传播，学校采取了很多措施。
措施.en: The school took many measures to stop colds from spreading.

导演.zh: 她想当一名电影导演，拍自己的故事。
导演.en: She wants to become a film director and make her own stories.

利益.zh: 为了公司的长远利益，我们必须改变现在的做法。

连续.en: This TV series has been airing continuously for two months.

阻止.en: He has decided to quit his job, and nobody can stop him.

资源.en: This country is very rich in oil resources.

主席.en: The meeting was chaired by the chairman of the company's board.

形成.en: The mountains here were formed millions of years ago.

一辈子.en: Grandpa has lived in this little village all his life.

行业.en: In recent years, online shopping has driven the growth of the delivery industry.

士兵.en: The soldiers braved the heavy rain to help villagers move their grain to higher ground.

配合.en: Patients should cooperate with the doctor's treatment if they want to recover quickly.

单位.en: My dad's workplace is close to home, so he walks to work every day.

显得.en: With a few pots of flowers in it, the room looks more lively.

物质.en: Air is made up of many substances, and we can't see it.

亲自.zh: 校长亲自给获奖的学生颁发了奖状。
亲自.en: The principal personally handed out certificates to the prize-winning students.

承担.zh: 这么多工作，一个人很难承担。
承担.en: It's hard for one person to take on this much work.

面临.zh: 毕业生们面临着找工作的压力。
面临.en: Graduates are facing the pressure of finding a job.

神秘.zh: 她最近很神秘，每天晚上都不知道去哪儿了。
神秘.en: She's been very mysterious lately; nobody knows where she goes every evening.

自动.en: At seven in the evening, the street lights come on automatically.

明确.zh: 这次会议的目的不太明确，大家都不知道要讨论什么。
明确.en: The purpose of this meeting isn't clear, and nobody knows what to discuss.

结合.en: This dish combines Chinese and French cooking methods.

登记.en: Participants, please register your names at the front desk first.

烂.en: I've worn these shoes for five years, and they're worn out.

充分.zh: 他的理由很充分，大家都被说服了。
充分.en: His reasons were well-founded, and everyone was persuaded.

批.zh: 图书馆新到了一批儿童读物。
批.en: The library has just received a new batch of children's books.

主人.zh: 今天的晚会上，他是主人，我们都是客人。
主人.en: At tonight's party he's the host, and we're all guests.

经典.zh: 这本小说是一部经典作品，值得反复阅读。
经典.en: This novel is a classic, worth reading again and again.

法院.zh: 法院判决这家公司赔偿顾客五万元。
法院.en: The court ordered the company to pay the customer 50,000 yuan in compensation.

醉.en: He can't hold his drink; one glass of beer gets him drunk.

工人.en: This bridge was built by several thousand workers over three years.

念.en: She goes to university in Beijing and only comes home in the winter holidays.

背景.en: The background of this photo is the open sea.

进步.en: As long as you keep practicing every day, you will definitely improve.

现象.en: A rainbow appearing after rain is a natural phenomenon.

道德.en: Doing business also requires ethics; you can't cheat customers.

万一.en: Make copies of important documents before going abroad, so it's fine if they get lost.

坚强.en: Although she's only ten, she is very strong and never cries.

脑袋.zh: 这道题太难了，我想得脑袋都疼了。
脑袋.en: This problem is so hard that thinking about it has given me a headache.

吵.zh: 爸爸在睡觉，你们小声点儿，别把他吵醒了。
吵.en: Dad is asleep; keep your voices down and don't wake him up.

温暖.zh: 志愿者们用爱心温暖了每一位老人的心。
温暖.en: With their kindness, the volunteers warmed the heart of every elderly person.

祝福.zh: 在婚礼上，大家纷纷向新郎新娘表达了祝福。
祝福.en: At the wedding, everyone in turn offered their good wishes to the bride and groom.

承受.zh: 这座桥最多能承受二十吨的重量。
承受.en: This bridge can bear a maximum weight of twenty tonnes.

公主.zh: 女儿生日那天，穿上了一条漂亮的公主裙。
公主.en: On her birthday, my daughter put on a pretty princess dress.

人口.zh: 由于年轻人都去了城市，这个村子的人口越来越少。
人口.en: Because the young people have all gone to the cities, the village's population keeps shrinking.

咨询.zh: 如果对产品有任何问题，欢迎拨打电话咨询。
咨询.en: If you have any questions about the product, you are welcome to call us for advice.

表面.zh: 这张桌子的表面很光滑，摸起来很舒服。
表面.en: The surface of this table is very smooth and feels nice to touch.

地位.zh: 在他心里，家人永远占据着最重要的地位。
地位.en: In his heart, his family always holds the most important place.

青.zh: 妈妈总是让我多吃青菜，少吃油炸食品。
青.en: Mum always tells me to eat more green vegetables and less fried food.

结构.zh: 这座房子的结构很结实，经历了几次地震都没有倒。
结构.en: The structure of this house is very solid; it has survived several earthquakes without collapsing.

妇女.zh: 每年三月八日是国际妇女节，公司会给女员工放半天假。
妇女.en: March 8th every year is International Women's Day, and the company gives its female staff half a day off.

矛盾.zh: 她心里很矛盾，不知道该留在北京还是回老家。
矛盾.en: She feels very conflicted and doesn't know whether to stay in Beijing or go back to her hometown.

吻.zh: 分别的时候，他给了女儿一个长长的吻。
吻.en: When they said goodbye, he gave his daughter a long kiss.

完整.zh: 这只古代花瓶保存得很完整，几乎没有一点儿损坏。
完整.en: This ancient vase is very well preserved and has almost no damage at all.

碰.zh: 真巧，我昨天在超市碰到了多年不见的老同学。
碰.en: What a coincidence: yesterday at the supermarket I ran into an old classmate I hadn't seen for years.

煮.zh: 面条煮好以后，放一点儿青菜会更好吃。
煮.en: Once the noodles are cooked, adding a few greens makes them tastier.

谈判.zh: 经过三天的谈判，买卖双方终于在价格上达成了一致。
谈判.en: After three days of negotiation, the buyer and seller finally agreed on a price.

在乎.zh: 只要你过得开心，钱多钱少我都不在乎。
在乎.en: As long as you are happy, I don't care whether you earn a lot or a little.

请求.zh: 船在海上出了故障，船长立刻通过无线电请求帮助。
请求.en: The boat broke down at sea, and the captain immediately radioed for help.

纪念.zh: 我们在长城上买了一些小东西作为纪念。
纪念.en: We bought some small things on the Great Wall as souvenirs.

插.zh: 手机快没电了，你帮我把充电器插上吧。
插.en: My phone is almost out of battery; could you plug in the charger for me?

分别.zh: 老师分别和每位同学谈了话，了解他们的想法。
分别.en: The teacher talked with each student separately to understand their thoughts.

愿望.zh: 生日那天，他闭上眼睛，许了一个愿望。
愿望.en: On his birthday, he closed his eyes and made a wish.

圆.zh: 这张桌子是圆的，可以坐下十个人。
圆.en: This table is round and can seat ten people.

广场.zh: 新年晚上，很多人聚在市中心的广场上等着看烟花。
广场.en: On New Year's Eve, many people gather in the square in the city centre waiting to watch the fireworks.

度过.zh: 祝你和家人度过一个快乐的春节！
度过.en: Wishing you and your family a happy Spring Festival!

臭.zh: 这双袜子穿了三天没洗，已经臭了。
臭.en: These socks have been worn for three days without washing and they already stink.

金属.zh: 这种金属很轻，常常被用来做飞机的零件。
金属.en: This metal is very light and is often used to make aircraft parts.

灰.zh: 他穿着一件灰色的大衣，站在门口等我。
灰.en: He was wearing a grey coat and standing at the door waiting for me.

堆.zh: 院子里堆满了刚收下来的玉米。
堆.en: The yard was piled high with freshly harvested corn.

保留.zh: 这个座位是给王老师保留的，请您坐别的地方。
保留.en: This seat is reserved for Teacher Wang; please sit somewhere else.

频道.zh: 孩子们最喜欢看少儿频道播放的动画片。
频道.en: The children love watching the cartoons shown on the kids' channel.

公寓.zh: 这栋公寓楼一共有二十层，住着两百多户人家。
公寓.en: This apartment building has twenty floors and over two hundred households live in it.

弱.zh: 这里的手机信号很弱，电话总是打不通。
弱.en: The phone signal here is very weak, and calls never get through.

不足.zh: 睡眠不足会让人白天没有精神。
不足.en: Not getting enough sleep leaves you without energy during the day.

业务.zh: 小王刚来公司，对业务还不太熟悉。
业务.en: Xiao Wang has just joined the company and isn't yet familiar with the work.

驾驶.zh: 飞行员驾驶着飞机安全降落在机场。
驾驶.en: The pilot flew the plane to a safe landing at the airport.

计算.zh: 这道数学题我计算了三遍，答案都一样。
计算.en: I calculated this maths problem three times and got the same answer each time.

开发.zh: 这个地区的旅游资源还没有被开发出来。
开发.en: The tourism resources in this area have not yet been developed.

晕.zh: 他坐船的时候总是头晕，所以很少出海。
晕.en: He always feels dizzy on boats, so he rarely goes out to sea.

甲.zh: 合同中的甲方是我们公司，乙方是那家工厂。
甲.en: In the contract, Party A is our company and Party B is that factory.

始终.zh: 这几年来，他始终坚持每天早上跑步。
始终.en: Over these past few years, he has always kept up running every morning.

贡献.zh: 每个人都可以为保护环境贡献自己的一份力量。
贡献.en: Everyone can contribute their share to protecting the environment.

划.zh: 他不小心被玻璃划破了手指。
划.en: He accidentally cut his finger on a piece of glass.

出版.zh: 这本杂志每个月出版一期，很受年轻人欢迎。
出版.en: This magazine publishes one issue a month and is very popular with young people.

诊断.zh: 这种病早期很难诊断，很多人发现时已经很严重了。
诊断.en: This disease is hard to diagnose early, and by the time many people find out it is already serious.

临时.zh: 因为人手不够，商店找了几个临时工。
临时.en: Because they were short-staffed, the shop hired a few temporary workers.

单独.zh: 这个问题比较复杂，我们下次单独讨论吧。
单独.en: This issue is rather complicated; let's discuss it separately next time.

平衡.zh: 她一边骑车一边打电话，结果失去平衡摔倒了。
平衡.en: She was talking on the phone while cycling and ended up losing her balance and falling.

开放.zh: 他的父母思想很开放，从不干涉他交朋友。
开放.en: His parents are very open-minded and never interfere with the friends he makes.

瞧.zh: 你瞧你，衣服上全是泥，快去换一件吧。
瞧.en: Look at you, your clothes are covered in mud; go and change.

大型.zh: 城市西边新建了一座大型购物中心。
大型.en: A large shopping centre has just been built on the west side of the city.

搜索.zh: 只要在手机上搜索一下，就能找到附近的加油站。
搜索.en: Just do a quick search on your phone and you can find a nearby petrol station.

展开.zh: 她轻轻地把信展开，一个字一个字地读了起来。
展开.en: She gently unfolded the letter and began reading it word by word.

把握.zh: 这次考试我没什么把握，可能通不过。
把握.en: I'm not very sure about this exam; I might not pass.

酒吧.zh: 这条街上有很多酒吧，晚上特别热闹。
酒吧.en: There are many bars on this street, and it is especially lively at night.

胃.zh: 吃得太快对胃不好，你还是慢慢吃吧。
胃.en: Eating too fast is bad for your stomach; you'd better eat slowly.

成就.zh: 看到学生们都考上了大学，王老师很有成就感。
成就.en: Seeing all her students get into university gave Teacher Wang a great sense of achievement.

课程.zh: 这所大学开设了很多关于人工智能的课程。
课程.en: This university offers many courses on artificial intelligence.

踩.zh: 刚拖完的地板，别穿着鞋子踩上去。
踩.en: The floor has just been mopped; don't step on it with your shoes on.

激烈.zh: 两队比分一直很接近，比赛进行得非常激烈。
激烈.en: The scores of the two teams stayed close and the match was very intense.

想念.zh: 他在国外读书，非常想念家里的小狗。
想念.en: He is studying abroad and misses his dog at home very much.

勇气.zh: 在这么多人面前唱歌，需要很大的勇气。
勇气.en: Singing in front of so many people takes a lot of courage.

固定.zh: 刮大风以前，要把阳台上的花盆固定好。
固定.en: Before strong winds come, you should fix the flowerpots on the balcony firmly in place.

注册.zh: 新生需要在九月一日前到学校办理注册手续。
注册.en: New students need to complete registration at the school before September 1st.

果然.zh: 我猜他会迟到，他果然又是最后一个到的。
果然.en: I guessed he would be late, and sure enough he was the last to arrive again.

位于.zh: 我们学校位于城市的东边，靠近一个大公园。
位于.en: Our school is located in the east of the city, near a big park.

摇.zh: 小狗看见主人回来，高兴地摇着尾巴。
摇.en: Seeing its owner come home, the puppy happily wagged its tail.

培养.zh: 这位教练培养出了很多优秀的运动员。
培养.en: This coach has trained many outstanding athletes.

平静.zh: 风停了以后，湖面又变得很平静。
平静.en: After the wind stopped, the surface of the lake became calm again.

平安.zh: 祝你一路平安，到了别忘了发个消息。
平安.en: Have a safe trip, and don't forget to send a message when you arrive.

传说.zh: 传说很久以前，这座山里住着一位神仙。
传说.en: Legend has it that long ago an immortal lived in this mountain.

转变.zh: 他从一个害羞的学生转变成了自信的老师。
转变.en: He has changed from a shy student into a confident teacher.

至今.zh: 这座桥已经有五百多年的历史，至今还在使用。
至今.en: This bridge is over five hundred years old and is still in use to this day.

无数.zh: 夏天的夜晚，天上有无数颗星星。
无数.en: On summer nights there are countless stars in the sky.

后果.zh: 如果不按时吃药，后果会很严重。
后果.en: If you don't take your medicine on time, the consequences will be serious.

气氛.zh: 会议室里的气氛很紧张，谁也不说话。
气氛.en: The atmosphere in the meeting room was very tense, and nobody spoke.

违反.zh: 在考场上使用手机是违反考试规定的。
违反.en: Using a phone in the exam room violates the exam rules.

石头.zh: 这座古老的桥是用石头建成的。
石头.en: This ancient bridge was built of stone.

主持.zh: 她是一位很受欢迎的电视节目主持人。
主持.en: She is a very popular TV show host.

关闭.zh: 因为天气原因，机场暂时关闭了。
关闭.en: Because of the weather, the airport has been temporarily closed.

软.zh: 这种面包又香又软，老人和孩子都爱吃。
软.en: This bread is fragrant and soft, and both the elderly and children love it.

摄影.zh: 她参加了一个摄影比赛，拿了一等奖。
摄影.en: She entered a photography competition and won first prize.

交换.zh: 开会以前，两位经理先交换了一下意见。
交换.en: Before the meeting, the two managers first exchanged views.

文明.zh: 黄河流域是中华文明的发源地之一。
文明.en: The Yellow River basin is one of the birthplaces of Chinese civilisation.

届.zh: 这是本届运动会上最精彩的一场比赛。
届.en: This was the most exciting match of this year's sports meet.

挡.zh: 她用手挡住阳光，抬头看着天上的飞机。
挡.en: She shaded her eyes from the sun with her hand and looked up at the plane in the sky.

亿.zh: 这部电影上映一周，票房就超过了十亿元。
亿.en: Within a week of its release, the film's box office exceeded one billion yuan.

敏感.zh: 工资是个敏感话题，最好不要随便问别人。
敏感.en: Salary is a sensitive topic; it's best not to ask people about it casually.

运气.zh: 今天运气真好，一出门就打到了出租车。
运气.en: I was really lucky today: I got a taxi as soon as I stepped outside.

玩具.zh: 商场里新开了一家玩具店，孩子们都想进去看看。
玩具.en: A new toy shop has opened in the mall, and all the children want to go in and look.

年纪.zh: 您这么大年纪了，还每天坚持游泳，真了不起！
年纪.en: At your age you still go swimming every day; that's really impressive!

智慧.zh: 这座古老的建筑体现了古人的智慧。
智慧.en: This ancient building reflects the wisdom of the people of old.

教训.zh: 他上课又迟到了，被老师教训了一顿。
教训.en: He was late for class again and got a lecture from the teacher.

沟通.zh: 父母应该多和孩子沟通，了解他们在想什么。
沟通.en: Parents should communicate more with their children to understand what they are thinking.

手指.zh: 弹钢琴的人手指一般都比较长。
手指.en: People who play the piano usually have fairly long fingers.

结论.zh: 通过这次实验，我们得出了一个重要的结论。
结论.en: Through this experiment, we reached an important conclusion.

除非.zh: 这个周末我一定去，除非突然下大雨。
除非.en: I'll definitely go this weekend, unless there's a sudden heavy rain.

总之.zh: 这里有山有水，空气好，人也热情，总之是个养老的好地方。
总之.en: There are mountains and rivers, the air is clean and the people are friendly; in short, it's a great place to retire.

化学.zh: 这种饮料里加了很多化学物质，最好少喝。
化学.en: This drink has a lot of chemicals added to it, so you'd better drink less of it.

天空.zh: 秋天的天空又高又蓝，让人心情很好。
天空.en: The autumn sky is high and blue, and it puts people in a good mood.

怀孕.zh: 医生告诉她，怀孕期间最好不要喝咖啡。
怀孕.en: The doctor told her it's best not to drink coffee during pregnancy.

统一.zh: 学校要求全体学生穿统一的校服。
统一.en: The school requires all students to wear a uniform school outfit.

制度.zh: 这家公司实行弹性工作制度，员工可以自己安排上班时间。
制度.en: This company has a flexible working system, so staff can arrange their own working hours.

绕.zh: 他每天早上绕着公园跑三圈。
绕.en: Every morning he runs three laps around the park.

玉米.zh: 这家店的玉米汤又香又甜，我每次都点。
玉米.en: This restaurant's corn soup is fragrant and sweet; I order it every time.

工业.zh: 这座城市以汽车工业闻名全国。
工业.en: This city is famous throughout the country for its car industry.

身材.zh: 他身材高大，很适合打篮球。
身材.en: He is tall and well built, very suited to playing basketball.

设施.zh: 这家酒店的设施很新，还有一个室内游泳池。
设施.en: This hotel's facilities are new, and it even has an indoor swimming pool.

腰.zh: 长时间坐在电脑前，很容易腰酸背疼。
腰.en: Sitting in front of a computer for a long time easily gives you an aching lower back.

抱怨.zh: 顾客抱怨饭菜上得太慢，经理连忙道歉。
抱怨.en: The customers complained that the food was too slow to arrive, and the manager hurriedly apologised.

从事.zh: 她的父亲从事医学研究已经三十年了。
从事.en: Her father has worked in medical research for thirty years.

义务.zh: 在中国，孩子们要接受九年义务教育。
义务.en: In China, children receive nine years of compulsory education.

奇迹.zh: 这座建在山顶上的古城被称为建筑史上的奇迹。
奇迹.en: This ancient city built on a mountaintop is called a wonder of architectural history.

运用.zh: 这位画家很善于运用颜色，他的画特别鲜艳。
运用.en: This painter is very good at using colour; his paintings are especially vivid.

逐渐.zh: 来中国半年后，他逐渐适应了这里的生活。
逐渐.en: Half a year after coming to China, he gradually adapted to life here.

制定.zh: 学校制定了新的规定，上课时不许使用手机。
制定.en: The school has drawn up a new rule: phones may not be used during class.

沉默.zh: 他是个沉默的人，开会时很少发言。
沉默.en: He is a quiet person and seldom speaks in meetings.

独特.zh: 这种水果的味道很独特，有的人喜欢，有的人受不了。
独特.en: This fruit has a very distinctive taste: some people love it and some can't stand it.

交往.zh: 他们俩交往了三年，打算明年结婚。
交往.en: The two of them have been dating for three years and plan to marry next year.

各自.zh: 毕业以后，同学们忙着各自的工作，很少见面了。
各自.en: After graduating, the classmates got busy with their own jobs and rarely saw each other.

糟糕.zh: 这次考试考得很糟糕，我都不敢告诉妈妈。
糟糕.en: I did so terribly in this exam that I don't dare tell my mum.

砍.zh: 爷爷每天上山砍柴，用来做饭。
砍.en: Grandpa goes up the mountain every day to chop firewood for cooking.

拆.zh: 他迫不及待地拆开了朋友寄来的礼物。
拆.en: He couldn't wait to open the present his friend had sent.

退休.zh: 王老师明年就要退休了，学生们都舍不得他。
退休.en: Teacher Wang is retiring next year, and his students hate to see him go.

成果.zh: 这次展览展示了学生们一学期的学习成果。
成果.en: This exhibition shows the results of the students' learning over the semester.

蛇.zh: 草丛里突然爬出一条蛇，把我吓了一跳。
蛇.en: A snake suddenly slithered out of the grass and gave me a fright.

精力.zh: 孩子们精力旺盛，玩了一整天也不觉得累。
精力.en: The children are full of energy; they played all day without feeling tired.

等于.zh: 三加五等于八，这么简单的题你都不会？
等于.en: Three plus five equals eight; you can't even do such an easy question?

能源.zh: 风能和太阳能都是清洁能源，不会污染空气。
能源.en: Wind and solar power are both clean energy sources and don't pollute the air.

概念.zh: 很多年轻人对钱没有什么概念，花得特别快。
概念.en: Many young people have little concept of money and spend it very quickly.

宽.zh: 这条裤子太宽了，有没有小一号的？
宽.en: These trousers are too loose; do you have them a size smaller?

核心.zh: 这家公司掌握了核心技术，所以发展得很快。
核心.en: This company has mastered the core technology, so it has grown quickly.

据说.zh: 据说明天会有大风，航班可能会推迟。
据说.en: Reportedly there will be strong winds tomorrow, and flights may be delayed.

特征.zh: 你能说说你要找的那个孩子有什么外貌特征吗？
特征.en: Can you describe the physical features of the child you are looking for?

去世.zh: 这位著名作家去世后，留下了很多没出版的作品。
去世.en: After this famous writer passed away, he left behind many unpublished works.

县.zh: 这个县有很多有名的茶园，每年吸引大量游客。
县.en: This county has many famous tea gardens that attract large numbers of tourists every year.

平均.zh: 这个城市夏天的平均气温在三十度左右。
平均.en: The average summer temperature in this city is around thirty degrees.

询问.zh: 他打电话向酒店询问还有没有空房间。
询问.en: He called the hotel to ask whether they still had any vacant rooms.

事物.zh: 世界上的任何事物都在不断地变化。
事物.en: Everything in the world is constantly changing.

演讲.zh: 下周学校要举行英语演讲比赛，我报了名。
演讲.en: Next week the school is holding an English speech contest, and I've signed up.

温柔.zh: 这位护士对病人非常温柔，大家都很喜欢她。
温柔.en: This nurse is very gentle with her patients, and everyone likes her.

软件.zh: 这台电脑的软件太旧了，需要更新一下。
软件.en: The software on this computer is too old and needs updating.

严肃.zh: 这是一个严肃的问题，请大家认真对待。
严肃.en: This is a serious issue; please treat it seriously, everyone.

脖子.zh: 长颈鹿的脖子很长，能吃到高处的树叶。
脖子.en: Giraffes have long necks and can reach leaves high up in the trees.

否认.zh: 她否认自己生气了，可是脸都红了。
否认.en: She denied being angry, but her face had turned red.

肌肉.zh: 他每周去三次健身房，练出了一身肌肉。
肌肉.en: He goes to the gym three times a week and has built up muscles all over.

安慰.zh: 比赛输了以后，教练安慰队员们说下次再努力。
安慰.en: After losing the match, the coach comforted the players, saying they would try again next time.

过分.zh: 他开玩笑开得太过分了，把她都气哭了。
过分.en: His joking went too far and made her cry with anger.

寂寞.zh: 孩子们都去外地工作了，老人在家很寂寞。
寂寞.en: The children have all gone to work elsewhere, and the old man is very lonely at home.

国王.zh: 这座宫殿是三百年前的一位国王修建的。
国王.en: This palace was built by a king three hundred years ago.

反而.zh: 我本来想帮忙，没想到反而给他添了麻烦。
反而.en: I meant to help, but unexpectedly I caused him trouble instead.

体会.zh: 这次去山区支教，我深深体会到了教育的重要性。
体会.en: Teaching as a volunteer in the mountains this time, I deeply realised the importance of education.

豪华.zh: 他们结婚时没有办豪华的婚礼，只请了几位亲友吃饭。
豪华.en: They didn't hold a lavish wedding; they just invited a few relatives and friends for a meal.

培训.zh: 这家公司每年都会给员工提供免费的英语培训。
培训.en: This company provides its staff with free English training every year.

税.zh: 在这个国家买东西，价格里已经包含了税。
税.en: When you buy things in this country, tax is already included in the price.

王子.zh: 这部动画片讲的是一个小王子到处旅行的故事。
王子.en: This cartoon tells the story of a little prince who travels everywhere.

扩大.zh: 为了扩大影响，他们在网上做了很多广告。
扩大.en: To broaden their influence, they ran a lot of adverts online.

此外.zh: 他会说英语和法语，此外还懂一点儿日语。
此外.en: He speaks English and French, and besides that he knows a little Japanese.

安装.zh: 手机上安装太多应用，速度会变慢。
安装.en: If you install too many apps on your phone, it will slow down.

怀念.zh: 这首老歌让很多人怀念起了自己的学生时代。
怀念.en: This old song made many people nostalgic for their school days.

假如.zh: 假如你能回到过去，你最想改变哪件事？
假如.en: If you could go back in time, what would you most want to change?

幻想.zh: 现实很快打破了她对大城市生活的幻想。
幻想.en: Reality quickly shattered her illusions about big-city life.

甩.zh: 他刚从游泳池出来，用力把头发上的水甩掉。
甩.en: He had just got out of the pool and flicked the water off his hair hard.

相对.zh: 跟北方相比，南方冬天的气候相对温和。
相对.en: Compared with the north, the winter climate in the south is relatively mild.

改善.zh: 为了改善睡眠，他每天晚上都喝一杯热牛奶。
改善.en: To improve his sleep, he drinks a glass of hot milk every night.

拥抱.zh: 孩子张开双手，扑过来给了我一个大大的拥抱。
拥抱.en: The child opened his arms, rushed over and gave me a big hug.

晒.zh: 去海边玩了一周，他被太阳晒黑了。
晒.en: After a week at the seaside, he was tanned by the sun.

感激.zh: 他用感激的目光看着救了他的医生。
感激.en: He looked gratefully at the doctor who had saved him.

纪录.zh: 这位游泳运动员创造了新的全国纪录。
纪录.en: This swimmer set a new national record.

乖.zh: 宝宝乖，吃完饭妈妈带你去公园玩。
乖.en: Be a good baby; after you finish eating, Mummy will take you to play in the park.

农民.zh: 秋天到了，农民们忙着收庄稼。
农民.en: Autumn has come, and the farmers are busy harvesting their crops.

商品.zh: 节日期间，商场里的很多商品都在打折。
商品.en: During the holidays, many goods in the mall are on sale.

形势.zh: 下半场开始后，比赛的形势对我们越来越有利。
形势.en: After the second half started, the situation in the match turned more and more in our favour.

劝.zh: 他喝了很多酒还想开车，朋友们怎么劝都没用。
劝.en: He had drunk a lot and still wanted to drive; no matter how his friends tried to persuade him, it was no use.

娶.zh: 村里的小伙子都想娶她当老婆。
娶.en: All the young men in the village wanted to marry her.

运输.zh: 这家公司专门负责运输新鲜的海鲜。
运输.en: This company specialises in transporting fresh seafood.

利润.zh: 这家小店每件商品的利润虽然很低，但卖得很多。
利润.en: Although this little shop makes very little profit on each item, it sells a lot.

珍惜.zh: 时间过得很快，一定要珍惜在大学的每一天。
珍惜.en: Time flies, so be sure to treasure every day at university.

传播.zh: 感冒很容易通过空气传播，大家出门要戴口罩。
传播.en: Colds spread easily through the air, so everyone should wear a mask when going out.

匹.zh: 爷爷年轻时养过一匹马，每天骑着它去镇上。
匹.en: When Grandpa was young he kept a horse and rode it into town every day.

好奇.zh: 他对什么都很好奇，总是问个不停。
好奇.en: He is curious about everything and keeps asking questions.

集体.zh: 这次旅行是集体活动，请大家不要单独行动。
集体.en: This trip is a group activity, so please don't go off on your own.

收获.zh: 秋天是收获的季节，果园里的苹果都熟了。
收获.en: Autumn is the harvest season, and the apples in the orchard are all ripe.

装饰.zh: 房间里的装饰很简单，只有几幅画和一盆花。
装饰.en: The decoration in the room is simple: just a few paintings and a pot of flowers.

锅.zh: 炒菜之前，先把锅烧热再放油。
锅.en: Before stir-frying, heat the wok first and then add the oil.

太太.zh: 李先生的太太是一位中学老师。
太太.en: Mr Li's wife is a secondary school teacher.

落后.zh: 他生病请了两周假，学习成绩落后了不少。
落后.en: He took two weeks off sick, and his grades fell quite a way behind.

蹲.zh: 孩子们蹲在路边，认真地看着地上的蚂蚁。
蹲.en: The children squatted by the roadside, watching the ants on the ground intently.

轻易.zh: 他不会轻易相信陌生人说的话。
轻易.en: He doesn't readily believe what strangers say.

强调.zh: 医生强调，这种药一定要饭后吃。
强调.en: The doctor stressed that this medicine must be taken after meals.

丑.zh: 丑小鸭最后变成了一只美丽的天鹅。
丑.en: The ugly duckling finally turned into a beautiful swan.

冒险.zh: 她喜欢冒险，一个人去过很多偏远的地方。
冒险.en: She loves adventure and has been to many remote places on her own.

分配.zh: 大学毕业后，他被分配到一所中学当老师。
分配.en: After graduating from university, he was assigned to a secondary school as a teacher.

账户.zh: 他在银行开了一个账户，专门用来存孩子的学费。
账户.en: He opened a bank account just for saving his child's school fees.

修改.zh: 这份合同还有几个地方需要修改，签字前再看看。
修改.en: A few places in this contract still need revising; look it over again before signing.

冻.zh: 把肉放进冰箱里冻起来，可以保存很久。
冻.en: If you freeze the meat in the fridge, it will keep for a long time.

要不.zh: 今天太累了，要不我们叫外卖吧？
要不.en: I'm too tired today; how about we order takeaway?

辞职.zh: 他觉得这份工作没有发展前途，就递交了辞职信。
辞职.en: He felt this job had no future, so he handed in his resignation letter.

遵守.zh: 大家既然商量好了，就要遵守约定，不能随便改。
遵守.en: Since we have all agreed on it, we should keep to the agreement and not change it at will.

抓紧.zh: 车上人很多，请抓紧扶手，注意安全。
抓紧.en: The bus is crowded; please hold the handrail tightly and stay safe.

相处.zh: 这只猫和家里的狗相处得很好，经常睡在一起。
相处.en: This cat gets along well with the family dog; they often sleep together.

戒.zh: 爸爸喝了二十年酒，去年终于戒掉了。
戒.en: Dad drank for twenty years and finally quit last year.

反映.zh: 如果对食堂的饭菜不满意，可以向学校反映。
反映.en: If you are not satisfied with the canteen food, you can report it to the school.

保存.zh: 写完文件后别忘了保存，不然停电就没了。
保存.en: Don't forget to save the file when you finish writing, or it will be lost if the power goes out.

阵.zh: 窗外吹来一阵凉风，让人觉得很舒服。
阵.en: A gust of cool wind blew in through the window, and it felt very pleasant.

日期.zh: 请在表格上写清楚你的出生日期。
日期.en: Please write your date of birth clearly on the form.

瞎.zh: 你根本不了解情况，就别在这儿瞎说了。
瞎.en: You don't understand the situation at all, so stop talking nonsense here.

从此.zh: 她在一次旅行中爱上了画画，从此每天都画。
从此.en: She fell in love with painting on a trip, and from then on she painted every day.

地震.zh: 日本是一个经常发生地震的国家。
地震.en: Japan is a country where earthquakes happen often.

赔偿.zh: 我不小心打破了商店的花瓶，只好照价赔偿。
赔偿.en: I accidentally broke a vase in the shop, so I had to pay for it at full price.

发明.zh: 造纸术是中国古代的四大发明之一。
发明.en: Papermaking is one of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China.

播放.zh: 上课的时候，老师给我们播放了一段视频。
播放.en: During the lesson, the teacher played a video for us.

挥.zh: 比赛开始前，球迷们在看台上挥着旗子为队员加油。
挥.en: Before the match began, the fans in the stands waved flags to cheer the players on.

突出.zh: 这篇文章的重点不够突出，读者很难抓住主要意思。
突出.en: The key points of this essay aren't prominent enough, so readers find it hard to grasp the main idea.

电池.zh: 这个玩具需要两节五号电池。
电池.en: This toy needs two AA batteries.

乐观.zh: 医生说他的病情很乐观，过几天就能出院了。
乐观.en: The doctor said his condition looks promising and he can leave hospital in a few days.

实话.zh: 面试的时候不知道答案，就实话实说，不要乱编。
实话.en: If you don't know the answer in an interview, just tell the truth; don't make things up.

青少年.zh: 这本杂志是专门为青少年编写的。
青少年.en: This magazine is written especially for teenagers.

无所谓.zh: 输赢无所谓，重要的是大家玩得开心。
无所谓.en: Winning or losing doesn't matter; what matters is that everyone has fun.

老鼠.zh: 猫和老鼠的动画片我小时候看了很多遍。
老鼠.en: As a child I watched the cat-and-mouse cartoon many times.

涨.zh: 下了一夜大雨，河水涨了很多。
涨.en: After a whole night of heavy rain, the river rose a lot.

热烈.zh: 他的演出结束后，观众们报以热烈的掌声。
热烈.en: When his performance ended, the audience responded with warm applause.

吨.zh: 这头成年大象的体重超过了五吨。
吨.en: This adult elephant weighs more than five tonnes.

相似.zh: 这两道题的解法相似，你可以参考一下前面那道。
相似.en: These two problems are solved in similar ways, so you can refer to the previous one.

移民.zh: 这个国家每年都会接收大量来自世界各地的移民。
移民.en: Every year this country takes in large numbers of immigrants from all over the world.

担任.zh: 他上大学时担任过学生会主席。
担任.en: When he was at university, he served as president of the student union.

趁.zh: 趁热吃吧，饺子凉了就不好吃了。
趁.en: Eat them while they're hot; dumplings don't taste good once they're cold.

宿舍.zh: 学校的宿舍晚上十一点关门，回来晚了就进不去了。
宿舍.en: The school dorms close at eleven at night; if you come back late you can't get in.

秩序.zh: 地铁站里有工作人员维持秩序。
秩序.en: There are staff in the subway station keeping order.

风景.zh: 坐在火车上，可以看到窗外美丽的风景。
风景.en: Sitting on the train, you can see beautiful scenery outside the window.

善良.zh: 这个故事告诉孩子们，做人要诚实、善良。
善良.en: This story teaches children to be honest and kind-hearted.

可靠.zh: 这个消息的来源很可靠，你可以放心。
可靠.en: The source of this news is very reliable, so you can rest assured.

其余.zh: 这些钱我只用了一半，其余的都存进了银行。
其余.en: I only used half of this money and put the rest in the bank.

规模.zh: 这次展览的规模很大，有一百多个国家参加。
规模.en: This exhibition is very large in scale, with over a hundred countries taking part.

决心.zh: 他这次减肥的决心很大，每天都坚持去跑步。
决心.en: He is very determined to lose weight this time and goes running every day.

忍不住.zh: 看到这么可爱的小狗，她忍不住摸了摸它。
忍不住.en: Seeing such a cute puppy, she couldn't help stroking it.

球迷.zh: 世界杯期间，很多球迷熬夜看比赛。
球迷.en: During the World Cup, many fans stay up late to watch the matches.

捡.zh: 秋天，孩子们在树下捡了很多落叶。
捡.en: In autumn, the children picked up lots of fallen leaves under the trees.

蔬菜.zh: 这家超市的蔬菜都是当天从农村运来的，非常新鲜。
蔬菜.en: The vegetables in this supermarket are brought in from the countryside the same day, so they're very fresh.

哪怕.zh: 哪怕只有一点儿希望，我们也不能放弃。
哪怕.en: Even if there is only a little hope, we can't give up.

补充.zh: 我说完了，大家还有什么要补充的吗？
补充.en: I've finished; does anyone have anything to add?

最初.zh: 这家公司最初只有五个人，现在已经有上千名员工了。
最初.en: This company started with only five people and now has over a thousand employees.

克服.zh: 为了上台演讲，她努力克服了自己的紧张情绪。
克服.en: To give the speech on stage, she worked hard to overcome her nerves.

摩托车.zh: 骑摩托车的时候，一定要戴好头盔。
摩托车.en: When riding a motorbike, you must wear a helmet properly.

薄.zh: 这本书很薄，一个晚上就能看完。
薄.en: This book is very thin; you can finish it in one evening.

贸易.zh: 他在一家国际贸易公司工作，经常出差。
贸易.en: He works for an international trading company and often travels on business.

装修.zh: 邻居家正在装修，每天都很吵。
装修.en: The neighbours are renovating their home, and it's noisy every day.

成分.zh: 买化妆品之前，最好先看看里面的成分。
成分.en: Before buying cosmetics, it's best to check the ingredients first.

召开.zh: 下个月将在北京召开一次国际医学会议。
召开.en: An international medical conference will be held in Beijing next month.

平常.zh: 这件事看起来很平常，其实并不简单。
平常.en: This matter looks ordinary, but it actually isn't simple at all.

代替.zh: 现在很多人用手机代替了手表。
代替.en: Nowadays many people use their phones in place of watches.

文字.zh: 这本书的文字很简单，小学生也能看懂。
文字.en: The writing in this book is very simple; even primary school pupils can understand it.

借口.zh: 迟到就是迟到，别再找借口了。
借口.en: Late is late; stop making excuses.

有利.zh: 这次比赛在主场进行，对我们很有利。
有利.en: This match is being played at home, which is very advantageous for us.

博物馆.zh: 这座博物馆里收藏着很多珍贵的古代书画。
博物馆.en: This museum houses many precious ancient paintings and calligraphy works.

热爱.zh: 他从小就热爱大自然，长大后成了一名生物学家。
热爱.en: He loved nature from childhood and became a biologist when he grew up.

体现.zh: 一个人的穿着往往能体现出他的性格。
体现.en: The way a person dresses often reflects their personality.

生长.zh: 这棵树生长在悬崖边上，已经一百多年了。
生长.en: This tree grows on the edge of a cliff and is over a hundred years old.

总裁.zh: 这家公司的总裁每天早上七点就到办公室了。
总裁.en: The company's CEO arrives at the office at seven every morning.

论文.zh: 他的论文发表在一本很有名的科学杂志上。
论文.en: His paper was published in a very famous science journal.

特色.zh: 这条街上都是有特色的小店，卖各种手工艺品。
特色.en: This street is full of distinctive little shops selling all kinds of handicrafts.

从而.zh: 这项新技术缩短了生产时间，从而降低了成本。
从而.en: This new technology shortened production time, thereby lowering costs.

整体.zh: 这套房子整体来说还不错，就是厨房小了点儿。
整体.en: On the whole this flat is quite good; it's just that the kitchen is a bit small.

综合.zh: 这家医院是本市最大的综合医院。
综合.en: This hospital is the largest general hospital in the city.

形容.zh: 这里的美景，简直无法用语言来形容。
形容.en: The beauty of this place simply can't be described in words.

青春.zh: 这部电影讲述了几个大学生的青春故事。
青春.en: This film tells the story of several university students' youth.

列车.zh: 本次列车的终点站是广州，请旅客们带好行李。
列车.en: The final stop of this train is Guangzhou; passengers, please take your luggage with you.

吸收.zh: 这种毛巾吸收水分的能力很强。
吸收.en: This kind of towel is very good at absorbing water.

迎接.zh: 为了迎接新年，大家把教室打扫得干干净净。
迎接.en: To welcome the New Year, everyone cleaned the classroom spotless.

改进.zh: 根据用户的意见，这款手机在设计上做了很多改进。
改进.en: Based on users' feedback, many improvements were made to the design of this phone.

舒适.zh: 这双鞋穿起来很舒适，走一天路也不累。
舒适.en: These shoes are very comfortable; you don't get tired even after walking all day.

建设.zh: 这个小村庄经过几年的建设，变得越来越美了。
建设.en: After a few years of construction work, this small village has become more and more beautiful.

文学.zh: 这位作家获得了诺贝尔文学奖。
文学.en: This writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature.

会计.zh: 公司的账目都由会计负责管理。
会计.en: The company's accounts are all managed by the accountant.

仿佛.zh: 她笑得那么开心，仿佛什么事也没发生过。
仿佛.en: She was laughing so happily, as if nothing had happened.

漏.zh: 屋顶漏雨了，我们得赶快找人来修。
漏.en: The roof is leaking rain; we need to get someone to fix it quickly.

狮子.zh: 在非洲草原上，我们看到了一群正在休息的狮子。
狮子.en: On the African grassland, we saw a group of lions resting.

屋子.zh: 她把屋子收拾得干干净净，等着客人来。
屋子.en: She tidied the room spotless and waited for the guests to come.

应付.zh: 他对工作只是应付，从来不认真。
应付.en: He just goes through the motions at work and is never serious about it.

雾.zh: 太阳出来以后，河面上的雾慢慢散了。
雾.en: After the sun came out, the mist over the river slowly cleared.

家乡.zh: 每到春节，他都要回家乡看望父母。
家乡.en: Every Spring Festival he goes back to his hometown to visit his parents.

伸.zh: 小猫伸了个懒腰，又躺下睡着了。
伸.en: The kitten stretched, then lay down and fell asleep again.

奋斗.zh: 经过十年的奋斗，他终于有了自己的公司。
奋斗.en: After ten years of striving, he finally had his own company.

消费.zh: 节假日期间，人们的消费明显增加了。
消费.en: During the holidays, people's spending rose noticeably.

吵架.zh: 夫妻之间难免会吵架，关键是要互相理解。
吵架.en: Couples inevitably argue; the key is to understand each other.

口味.zh: 四川菜口味比较重，很多人吃不了那么辣。
口味.en: Sichuan food has strong flavours, and many people can't handle that much spice.

具备.zh: 这座城市还不具备举办大型运动会的条件。
具备.en: This city does not yet have the conditions to host a large sports event.

姿势.zh: 拍照的时候，她摆了一个很可爱的姿势。
姿势.en: When the photo was taken, she struck a very cute pose.

干脆.zh: 他说话很干脆，从来不绕弯子。
干脆.en: He speaks very directly and never beats about the bush.

不安.zh: 孩子这么晚还没回家，妈妈心里越来越不安。
不安.en: It was so late and the child still wasn't home, and the mother grew more and more uneasy.

谨慎.zh: 他开车一向很谨慎，从来没出过事故。
谨慎.en: He has always driven very cautiously and has never had an accident.

尽力.zh: 这次比赛虽然输了，但大家都已经尽力了。
尽力.en: Although we lost this match, everyone did their best.

陌生.zh: 爸爸妈妈不在家时，不要随便给陌生人开门。
陌生.en: When Mum and Dad aren't home, don't open the door to strangers.

扶.zh: 护士扶着病人慢慢地走到窗边。
扶.en: The nurse supported the patient as he slowly walked to the window.

下载.zh: 手机内存满了，新的应用下载不了。
下载.en: My phone's storage is full, so new apps can't be downloaded.

维修.zh: 我的电脑坏了，送到维修中心修了一个星期。
维修.en: My computer broke, and it spent a week at the repair centre.

构成.zh: 这个对手实力很强，对我们队构成了很大的威胁。
构成.en: This opponent is very strong and poses a serious threat to our team.

忽然.zh: 他正要出门，忽然想起忘了带钥匙。
忽然.en: Just as he was going out, he suddenly remembered he had forgotten his keys.

肩膀.zh: 他把孩子放在肩膀上，让他看清楚前面的表演。
肩膀.en: He put the child on his shoulders so he could see the performance in front clearly.

发言.zh: 轮到他发言的时候，他紧张得说不出话来。
发言.en: When it was his turn to speak, he was so nervous he couldn't get a word out.

挣.zh: 他靠周末做家教挣了一些零花钱。
挣.en: He earned some pocket money by tutoring at weekends.

观念.zh: 我奶奶的观念很传统，认为女孩子应该早点儿结婚。
观念.en: My grandmother's views are very traditional; she thinks girls should marry early.

催.zh: 快点儿吧，出租车司机已经在楼下催了好几次了。
催.en: Hurry up, the taxi driver downstairs has already hurried us several times.

改革.zh: 这家工厂经过改革，生产效率提高了很多。
改革.en: After reform, this factory's production efficiency improved a lot.

告别.zh: 演出结束时，这位老歌手含着眼泪向观众告别。
告别.en: At the end of the show, the old singer bade farewell to the audience with tears in his eyes.

秘书.zh: 新来的秘书工作很认真，经理对她很满意。
秘书.en: The new secretary works very conscientiously, and the manager is very pleased with her.

捐.zh: 她把自己不穿的衣服都捐给了山区的孩子。
捐.en: She donated all the clothes she no longer wears to children in the mountain areas.

卧室.zh: 这套房子有两间卧室和一个小客厅。
卧室.en: This flat has two bedrooms and a small living room.

假装.zh: 妈妈进来的时候，他赶紧闭上眼睛假装睡着了。
假装.en: When Mum came in, he quickly shut his eyes and pretended to be asleep.

燃烧.zh: 木头燃烧的时候会产生很多烟。
燃烧.en: Wood gives off a lot of smoke when it burns.

牙齿.zh: 她笑起来露出一排白白的牙齿。
牙齿.en: When she smiles she shows a row of white teeth.

反复.zh: 医生反复叮嘱他，一定要按时吃药。
反复.en: The doctor told him over and over that he must take his medicine on time.

极其.zh: 这条山路极其危险，雨天最好不要走。
极其.en: This mountain road is extremely dangerous; it's best not to take it on rainy days.

尊敬.zh: 尊敬的各位来宾，欢迎大家参加今天的晚会。
尊敬.en: Respected guests, welcome to this evening's party.

宠物.zh: 这家酒店允许客人带宠物入住。
宠物.en: This hotel allows guests to stay with their pets.

模仿.zh: 这只鹦鹉很聪明，能模仿好几种动物的叫声。
模仿.en: This parrot is very clever and can imitate the calls of several animals.

破产.zh: 这家公司欠了银行很多钱，最后只好宣布破产。
破产.en: This company owed the bank a lot of money and in the end had to declare bankruptcy.

烫.zh: 她刚去理发店烫了头发，看起来年轻了好几岁。
烫.en: She has just had her hair permed at the salon and looks several years younger.

说不定.zh: 你再找找，说不定钥匙掉在沙发下面了。
说不定.en: Look again; maybe the keys fell under the sofa.

自豪.zh: 他自豪地告诉大家，这张桌子是他自己做的。
自豪.en: He proudly told everyone that he had made this table himself.

闯.zh: 他二十岁就离开家乡，到上海去闯天下。
闯.en: At twenty he left his hometown and went to Shanghai to make his way in the world.

戒指.zh: 她手上戴着一枚钻石戒指，非常漂亮。
戒指.en: She is wearing a diamond ring on her hand; it is very beautiful.

单纯.zh: 孩子的想法很单纯，喜欢就是喜欢。
单纯.en: Children think in a very simple way: if they like something, they like it.

比例.zh: 做蛋糕时，面粉和糖的比例很重要。
比例.en: When making a cake, the ratio of flour to sugar is very important.

输入.zh: 用手机输入汉字比用电脑慢一些。
输入.en: Typing Chinese characters on a phone is a bit slower than on a computer.

假设.zh: 科学家通过实验证明了这个假设是正确的。
假设.en: The scientists proved through experiments that this hypothesis was correct.

色彩.zh: 这座城市的建筑色彩丰富，像童话世界一样。
色彩.en: The buildings in this city are richly coloured, like a fairy-tale world.

逃避.zh: 你不能总是逃避责任，这件事你必须负责。
逃避.en: You can't keep evading responsibility; you have to take responsibility for this.

健身.zh: 公司楼下新开了一家健身中心，我办了张卡。
健身.en: A new fitness centre has opened below our office, and I've got a membership card.

劳动.zh: 五月一日是国际劳动节，大家放假三天。
劳动.en: May 1st is International Labour Day, and everyone gets three days off.

事先.zh: 去那家餐厅吃饭，最好事先打电话订个座位。
事先.en: If you're eating at that restaurant, it's best to call ahead and book a table.

失业.zh: 经济不好的时候，失业的人会增加。
失业.en: When the economy is bad, the number of unemployed people rises.

规律.zh: 掌握了学习语言的规律，进步就会快很多。
规律.en: Once you grasp the patterns of language learning, you will progress much faster.

待遇.zh: 她嫌这家公司的工资待遇太低，没去面试。
待遇.en: She thought the pay and benefits at this company were too low, so she didn't go to the interview.

淡.zh: 病刚好，饭菜要做得淡一些，少放油盐。
淡.en: You've only just recovered, so the food should be a bit bland, with less oil and salt.

逗.zh: 这只小猫太好玩了，孩子们一直在逗它。
逗.en: This kitten is such fun that the children keep teasing it.

飘.zh: 秋风一吹，树叶纷纷从树上飘了下来。
飘.en: When the autumn wind blew, leaves came fluttering down from the trees.

物理.zh: 牛顿是一位伟大的物理学家。

前途.zh: 她放弃了一份很有前途的工作，回老家照顾父母。
前途.en: She gave up a very promising job and went back home to look after her parents.

营养.zh: 孩子正在长身体，需要多补充营养。
营养.en: Children are still growing and need plenty of nutrition.

平等.zh: 在我们家，男孩和女孩受到的待遇是平等的。
平等.en: In our family, boys and girls are treated equally.

说服.zh: 他用事实说服了大家，最后计划通过了。
说服.en: He convinced everyone with facts, and in the end the plan was approved.

打工.zh: 他十六岁就出来打工，帮家里挣钱。
打工.en: At sixteen he went out to work odd jobs to earn money for his family.

自愿.zh: 这些年轻人都是自愿来帮忙的，没有拿一分钱。
自愿.en: These young people all came to help of their own free will and didn't take a penny.

朵.zh: 她在头发上戴了一朵小黄花。
朵.en: She wore a little yellow flower in her hair.

成人.zh: 孩子长大成人以后，父母也该学着放手了。
成人.en: Once children have grown up, parents should learn to let go.

总算.zh: 找了整整一个下午，我总算找到了丢失的钥匙。
总算.en: After searching for a whole afternoon, I finally found my lost keys.

汽油.zh: 最近汽油价格又涨了，开车的成本越来越高。
汽油.en: Petrol prices have gone up again recently, and the cost of driving keeps rising.

浓.zh: 山上的雾很浓，几米以外的东西都看不清。
浓.en: The fog on the mountain is very thick; you can't see anything a few metres away.

活跃.zh: 他的到来让晚会的气氛一下子活跃了起来。
活跃.en: His arrival livened up the atmosphere of the party at once.

毛病.zh: 他有个坏毛病，吃饭的时候总是看手机。
毛病.en: He has a bad habit: he always looks at his phone while eating.

逻辑.zh: 这篇文章逻辑混乱，读了半天也不知道作者想说什么。
逻辑.en: The logic of this essay is muddled; after reading it for ages I still don't know what the author wants to say.

兔子.zh: 这只兔子跑得飞快，一下子就不见了。
兔子.en: The rabbit ran off like lightning and was gone in an instant.

忽视.zh: 他工作太忙，常常忽视了家人的感受。
忽视.en: He is so busy with work that he often neglects his family's feelings.

密切.zh: 这两件事之间有着密切的关系。
密切.en: These two matters are closely related.

哲学.zh: 这本哲学书讨论了人生的意义。
哲学.en: This philosophy book discusses the meaning of life.

夸张.zh: 这个演员的表演太夸张了，一点儿都不自然。
夸张.en: This actor's performance is too exaggerated and not natural at all.

光明.zh: 黑暗过后，总会迎来光明。

卡车.zh: 这条路很窄，大卡车开不进来。
卡车.en: This road is very narrow; big lorries can't get in.

嘉宾.zh: 参加婚礼的嘉宾有两百多人。
嘉宾.en: More than two hundred guests attended the wedding.

象征.zh: 在很多国家，白色的鸽子是和平的象征。
象征.en: In many countries, the white dove is a symbol of peace.

射击.zh: 她在奥运会射击比赛中获得了金牌。
射击.en: She won a gold medal in the shooting event at the Olympics.

本质.zh: 看问题要看本质，不能只看表面。
本质.en: When looking at a problem, look at its essence, not just the surface.

提问.zh: 记者会上，一位外国记者第一个举手提问。
提问.en: At the press conference, a foreign journalist was the first to raise his hand and ask a question.

录取.zh: 今年这所大学一共录取了三千名新生。
录取.en: This year the university admitted a total of three thousand new students.

浅.zh: 她穿了一件浅蓝色的连衣裙，看起来很清爽。
浅.en: She wore a light blue dress and looked fresh and neat.

犹豫.zh: 这件衣服很适合你，别犹豫了，买吧！
犹豫.en: This outfit really suits you; stop hesitating and buy it!

实践.zh: 他把在课堂上学到的理论用在了实践中。
实践.en: He put the theory he learned in class into practice.

坚决.zh: 妈妈态度很坚决，不让我一个人去旅行。
坚决.en: Mum was very firm and wouldn't let me travel alone.

从前.zh: 从前有一座山，山上有一座庙。
从前.en: Once upon a time there was a mountain, and on the mountain there was a temple.

日常.zh: 这个网站教大家日常用语，非常实用。
日常.en: This website teaches everyday expressions and is very practical.

老实.zh: 这孩子在学校很老实，从不惹麻烦。
老实.en: This child is very well-behaved at school and never causes trouble.

大厦.zh: 这座八十层的大厦是这座城市最高的建筑。
大厦.en: This eighty-storey tower is the tallest building in the city.

预防.zh: 为了预防火灾，楼里每层都放了灭火器。
预防.en: To prevent fires, there are fire extinguishers on every floor of the building.

效率.zh: 早上头脑清楚，学习效率最高。
效率.en: Your mind is clear in the morning, so that's when you study most efficiently.

情景.zh: 回想起小时候过年的情景，他觉得特别温暖。
情景.en: Recalling the scenes of New Year from his childhood, he felt especially warm.

必然.zh: 长期熬夜，身体必然会出问题。
必然.en: If you stay up late for a long time, your health is bound to suffer.

摘.zh: 进门后，他摘下帽子，向主人问好。
摘.en: After coming in, he took off his hat and greeted the host.

写作.zh: 这位作家每天早上写作四个小时。
写作.en: This writer writes for four hours every morning.

业余.zh: 他是一名业余足球运动员，平时在银行上班。
业余.en: He is an amateur footballer who normally works at a bank.

倒霉.zh: 怎么这么倒霉，刚买的新车就被人撞了。
倒霉.en: How unlucky: my brand-new car has just been hit by someone.

对比.zh: 两种颜色放在一起，对比非常强烈。
对比.en: Put the two colours together and the contrast is very strong.

危害.zh: 长时间玩手机会对孩子的眼睛造成危害。
危害.en: Using a phone for long periods can harm children's eyes.

手续.zh: 住酒店之前，要先在前台办理入住手续。
手续.en: Before staying at a hotel, you first have to complete the check-in formalities at the front desk.

争论.zh: 关于晚饭吃什么，兄弟俩争论了半天。
争论.en: The two brothers argued for ages about what to have for dinner.

休闲.zh: 这家书店里有咖啡，是个休闲的好地方。
休闲.en: This bookshop serves coffee and is a good place to relax.

戏剧.zh: 她大学读的是戏剧专业，毕业后成了演员。
戏剧.en: She majored in drama at university and became an actress after graduating.

难怪.zh: 原来他在中国住了十年，难怪汉语说得这么好。
难怪.en: So he has lived in China for ten years; no wonder his Chinese is so good.

围绕.zh: 地球围绕着太阳不停地转。
围绕.en: The Earth constantly revolves around the Sun.

隔壁.zh: 隔壁的狗叫了一个晚上，吵得我睡不着。
隔壁.en: The dog next door barked all night and kept me awake.

歪.zh: 他的领带歪了，自己却一点儿也没发现。
歪.en: His tie was crooked, but he didn't notice at all.

外交.zh: 他父亲是一名外交官，所以他在很多国家生活过。
外交.en: His father is a diplomat, so he has lived in many countries.

偶然.zh: 这个重要的发现完全是偶然的。
偶然.en: This important discovery was entirely accidental.

规矩.zh: 按照这里的规矩，进门前要先脱鞋。
规矩.en: According to the custom here, you take off your shoes before going in.

模糊.zh: 时间太久了，那件事我只有一个模糊的印象。
模糊.en: It was so long ago that I only have a vague impression of it.

赞成.zh: 大多数同学都赞成周末去郊游。
赞成.en: Most of the classmates are in favour of going on an outing at the weekend.

复制.zh: 这幅画是复制品，真的在博物馆里。
复制.en: This painting is a reproduction; the real one is in the museum.

消化.zh: 老年人消化能力比较差，最好吃些软的食物。
消化.en: Elderly people have weaker digestion, so it's best for them to eat soft food.

录音.zh: 开会的时候，他用手机录音，方便以后整理。
录音.en: During the meeting, he recorded it on his phone so he could sort out the notes later.

接待.zh: 这家宾馆每年接待游客十几万人。
接待.en: This hotel receives over a hundred thousand tourists every year.

疑问.zh: 毫无疑问，他是这个队里最好的球员。
疑问.en: Without a doubt, he is the best player on this team.

包裹.zh: 快递员把包裹放在了我家门口。
包裹.en: The courier left the parcel at my front door.

客观.zh: 作为裁判，他必须保持客观公正。
客观.en: As a referee, he must stay objective and fair.

善于.zh: 他不善于表达自己的感情，但心里很关心家人。
善于.en: He isn't good at expressing his feelings, but deep down he cares a lot about his family.

应用.zh: 这款手机应用可以帮你记录每天走了多少步。
应用.en: This phone app can help you track how many steps you walk each day.

丝毫.zh: 比赛输了，可他的脸上看不出丝毫失望。
丝毫.en: They lost the match, yet his face showed not the slightest disappointment.

包含.zh: 他的这句话里包含着对孩子深深的爱。
包含.en: His words carried a deep love for his child.

过敏.zh: 这种药可能会引起皮肤过敏，用之前要问医生。
过敏.en: This medicine may cause a skin allergy; ask a doctor before using it.

电台.zh: 这位主持人在广播电台工作了二十年。
电台.en: This host has worked at the radio station for twenty years.

总理.zh: 电视里正在播放总理的新年讲话。
总理.en: The TV is broadcasting the premier's New Year speech.

骨头.zh: 小狗趴在门口，高兴地啃着一块骨头。
骨头.en: The puppy lay at the door, happily gnawing on a bone.

集合.zh: 导游说参观结束后，大家在大巴车旁边集合。
集合.en: The guide said that after the visit everyone should gather beside the coach.

宝贵.zh: 通过这次比赛，我们积累了很多宝贵的经验。
宝贵.en: Through this competition we gained a lot of valuable experience.

睁.zh: 医生让他睁开眼睛，看看灯光。
睁.en: The doctor asked him to open his eyes and look at the light.

进口.zh: 这家超市卖很多进口食品，价格比较贵。
进口.en: This supermarket sells a lot of imported food, which is rather expensive.

工程师.zh: 这座大桥是由一位年轻的工程师设计的。
工程师.en: This bridge was designed by a young engineer.

土豆.zh: 晚饭我做了一盘土豆炖牛肉。
土豆.en: For dinner I made a plate of beef stewed with potatoes.

展览.zh: 这次汽车展览一直持续到月底，每天都有很多人参观。
展览.en: This car exhibition runs until the end of the month, and lots of people visit every day.

完善.zh: 这个软件的功能还不够完善，用户提了很多意见。
完善.en: The app's features are not yet well developed, and users have raised many complaints.

猴子.zh: 这只猴子很聪明，会自己剥香蕉皮吃。
猴子.en: This monkey is clever; it can peel a banana by itself.

参考.zh: 这道题的答案仅供参考，不一定完全正确。
参考.en: The answer to this question is for reference only and may not be entirely correct.

拦.zh: 他想闯红灯，被警察拦了下来。
拦.en: He tried to run the red light but was stopped by the police.

志愿者.zh: 图书馆每周六都需要志愿者帮忙整理图书。
志愿者.en: The library needs volunteers every Saturday to help sort the books.

重量.zh: 这个书架每一层能承受的最大重量是二十公斤。
重量.en: Each shelf of this bookcase can bear a maximum weight of 20 kilograms.

缓解.zh: 吃了这种药以后，他的头疼得到了缓解。
缓解.en: After taking this medicine, his headache was relieved.

多余.zh: 搬家前，她把多余的家具都送给了邻居。
多余.en: Before moving, she gave her surplus furniture to the neighbours.

发达.zh: 沿海城市经济比较发达，工作机会也更多。
发达.en: Coastal cities are more economically developed and have more job opportunities.

自私.zh: 他只想着自己的利益，这种自私的做法让同事们很失望。
自私.en: He thinks only of his own interests, and this selfish behaviour has disappointed his colleagues.

爱心.zh: 很多人献出爱心，为生病的小女孩捐了款。
爱心.en: Many people showed their kindness and donated money to the sick little girl.

商务.zh: 这家酒店主要接待来出差的商务客人。
商务.en: This hotel mainly serves business guests on work trips.

撕.zh: 她看完信，生气地把它撕成了碎片。
撕.en: After reading the letter, she angrily tore it to pieces.

天真.zh: 小女孩天真地问妈妈，月亮为什么会跟着我们走。
天真.en: The little girl innocently asked her mother why the moon follows us.

沙漠.zh: 骆驼能在沙漠里好几天不喝水。
沙漠.en: Camels can go several days without water in the desert.

语气.zh: 他用开玩笑的语气说出了自己的真实想法。
语气.en: He spoke his real thoughts in a joking tone.

形状.zh: 天上有一朵白云，形状很像一只大白兔。
形状.en: There's a white cloud in the sky shaped just like a big white rabbit.

披.zh: 下雨了，他披上雨衣就出门了。
披.en: It started raining, so he threw on a raincoat and went out.

了不起.zh: 这位老人七十岁还学会了用电脑，真是了不起！
了不起.en: This old man learned to use a computer at seventy—truly amazing!

证件.zh: 我的钱包丢了，里面的证件也都没有了。
证件.en: I lost my wallet, and all the ID papers in it are gone too.

幼儿园.zh: 女儿今年三岁，九月就要上幼儿园了。
幼儿园.en: My daughter is three this year and will start kindergarten in September.

影子.zh: 晚上路灯一照，地上就出现了我们的影子。
影子.en: When the street lamps shine at night, our shadows appear on the ground.

延长.zh: 考试期间，图书馆把开放时间延长到晚上十一点。
延长.en: During exams, the library extends its opening hours to 11 p.m.

地道.zh: 这家小饭馆做的是地道的四川菜。
地道.en: This little restaurant serves authentic Sichuan food.

数码.zh: 数码时代，很多人已经不再去照相馆洗照片了。
数码.en: In the digital age, many people no longer go to photo studios to print photos.

实习.zh: 医学院的学生最后一年要在医院实习。
实习.en: Medical students must do an internship at a hospital in their final year.

盆.zh: 阳台上那盆花好几天没浇水，叶子都黄了。
盆.en: The pot of flowers on the balcony hasn't been watered for days, and its leaves have turned yellow.

性质.zh: 这次事故的性质非常严重，必须认真调查。
性质.en: The nature of this accident is very serious and must be investigated carefully.

神话.zh: 这部电影是根据一个古老的神话改编的。
神话.en: This film is adapted from an ancient myth.

紫.zh: 秋天到了，葡萄都变成了深紫色。
紫.en: Autumn has come, and the grapes have all turned deep purple.

称呼.zh: 在中国，学生一般称呼老师为“王老师”“李老师”。
称呼.en: In China, students usually address teachers as "Teacher Wang" or "Teacher Li".

推广.zh: 这家公司正在网上推广他们的新产品。
推广.en: This company is promoting its new product online.

营业.zh: 春节期间，这家银行只营业半天。
营业.en: During the Spring Festival, this bank is open for only half a day.

古代.zh: 在古代，人们写信要花好几个月才能送到。
古代.en: In ancient times, a letter took several months to arrive.

问候.zh: 老同学见面，先互相问候了几句。
问候.en: When the old classmates met, they first exchanged a few greetings.

铃.zh: 我正在洗澡，门铃突然响了。
铃.en: I was taking a shower when the doorbell suddenly rang.

农业.zh: 这个国家大量使用机器来发展现代农业。
农业.en: This country makes wide use of machines to develop modern agriculture.

洒.zh: 夏天的早上，工人们在街上洒水降温。
洒.en: On summer mornings, workers spray water on the streets to cool them down.

纪律.zh: 这个班的课堂纪律很好，上课时没人说话。
纪律.en: This class has good discipline; nobody talks during lessons.

面积.zh: 这个湖的面积相当于十个足球场那么大。
面积.en: The area of this lake is equal to about ten football pitches.

闪电.zh: 小狗一看到闪电、听到雷声，就躲到床底下。
闪电.en: As soon as the puppy sees lightning and hears thunder, it hides under the bed.

桃.zh: 春天，山上的桃花都开了，粉红一片。
桃.en: In spring, the peach blossoms on the hill are all out, a sea of pink.

广泛.zh: 这种新技术已经被广泛应用在医疗领域。
广泛.en: This new technology is already widely used in medicine.

手套.zh: 洗碗的时候，她总是戴上橡胶手套保护双手。
手套.en: When washing dishes, she always puts on rubber gloves to protect her hands.

讽刺.zh: 这部喜剧用幽默的方式讽刺了社会上的浪费现象。
讽刺.en: This comedy uses humour to satirize wastefulness in society.

悄悄.zh: 妈妈悄悄地在女儿的书包里放了一张生日卡。
悄悄.en: Mum secretly slipped a birthday card into her daughter's schoolbag.

差距.zh: 虽然我进步了很多，但是和第一名还有很大的差距。
差距.en: Although I've improved a lot, there's still a big gap between me and the top student.

总共.zh: 我们班总共有三十八个学生。
